attacks.name: Phoenix Flame
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, shuffle Blaine's Moltres and all cards attached to it into your deck (after doing damage).

attacks.name: Lariat
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

ability.name: Bench Guard
ability.text: As long as Brock's Rhydon is Benched, whenever 1 of your Benched Pokemon is damaged, you may do 10 of that damage to Brock's Rhydon instead. (If more than 1 of your Benched Pokemon is damaged at the same time, you may use this power once for each of them.)

attacks.name: Fairy Power
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, you may return any number of your Pokemon in play and all cards attached to them to your hand.

attacks.name: Blizzard
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokemon. If tails, this attack does 10 damage to each of your own Benched Pokemon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokemon.)

attacks.name: Take Away
attacks.text: Shuffle Erika's Dragonair and all cards attached to it into your deck. Then, your opponent shuffles his or her Active Pokemon and all cards attached to it into his or her deck.

attacks.name: Mega Drain
attacks.text: If Erika's Vileplume does damage to the Defending Pokemon (after applying Weakness and Resistance), remove a number of damage counters from Erika's Vileplume equal to half the damage done to the Defending Pokemon (rounded up to the nearest 10). If Erika's Vileplume has fewer damage counters than that, remove all of them.

ability.name: Pollen Defense
ability.text: If an attack does damage to Erika's Vileplume while it's your Active Pokemon (even if it's Knocked Out), flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokemon is now Confused. This power works even while Erika's Vileplume is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Charge
attacks.text: Take up to 2 Lightning Energy cards from your discard pile and attach them to Lt. Surge's Electabuzz.

attacks.name: Discharge
attacks.text: Discard all Lightning Energy cards attached to Lt. Surge's Electabuzz in order to use this attack. Flip a number of coins equal to the number of Lightning Energy cards you discarded. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Repeating Drill
attacks.text: Flip 5 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Clutch
attacks.text: The Defending Pokemon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Mega Shock
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, Lt. Surge's Magneton does 20 damage to itself.

ability.name: Energy Charge
ability.text: As often as you like during your turn (before your attack), if Lt. Surge's Magneton is your Active Pokemon, you may take 1 Lightning Energy card attached to 1 of your Pokemon and attach it to Lt. Surge's Magneton. This power can't be used if Lt. Surge's Magneton is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Knockout Needle
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. If both of them are heads, this attack does 30 damage plus 60 more damage. If 1 or both of them are tails, this attack does 30 damage.

attacks.name: Jellyfish Poison
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokemon is now Poisoned. If tails, the Defending Pokemon is now Confused.

ability.name: Flee
ability.text: If an attack does damage to Misty's Tentacruel while it's your Active Pokemon, you may switch it with 1 of your Benched Pokemon, which prevents all other effects of that attack on Misty's Tentacruel. This power can't be used if Misty's Tentacruel is already Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Crosscounter
attacks.text: If an attack does damage to Rocket's Hitmonchan during your opponent's next turn (even if Rocket's Hitmonchan is Knocked Out), flip a coin. If heads, Rocket's Hitmonchan attacks your opponent's Active Pokemon for double that amount of damage. (If Rocket's Hitmonchan takes 20 damage, it does 40 damage to that Pokemon.)

attacks.name: Fire Wall
attacks.text: If an attack does damage to Rocket's Moltres during your opponent's next turn (even if Rocket's Moltres is Knocked Out), Rocket's Moltres attacks your opponent's Active Pokemon for 10 damage. (Apply Weakness and Resistance.)

ability.name: Rebirth
ability.text: When Rocket's Moltres is Knocked Out, you may return it to your hand after discarding it. This power can't be used if Rocket's Moltres is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed when it is Knocked Out.

attacks.name: Shadow Images
attacks.text: Whenever Rocket's Scyther is attacked, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, that attack does no damage to Rocket's Scyther. (Any other effects of the attack still happen.) This effect lasts until Rocket's Scyther takes damage (or is Benched or is evolved).

attacks.name: Pain Amplifier
attacks.text: Put a damage counter on each of your opponent's Pokemon has already has any damage counters on it.

attacks.name: Call of the Night
attacks.text: Unless this attack Knocks Out the Defending Pokemon, flip 2 coins. If both of them are heads, your opponent shuffles his or her Active Pokemon and all cards attached to it into his or her deck.

cards.name: Brock
cards.text: Remove 1 damage counter from each of your Pokemon that has any damage counters on it.

cards.name: Erika

cards.name: Lt. Surge

cards.name: Misty
cards.text: Discard 2 of the other cards in your hand in order to play this card. If this turn's attack does damage to the Defending Pokemon (after applying Weakness and Resistance), and if the attacking Pokemon has Misty in its name, the attack does 20 more damage to the Defending Pokemon.

cards.name: The Rocket's Trap

attacks.name: Moonwatching
attacks.text: Search your deck for a basic Energy card. Show that card to your opponent, then put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Comet Slap
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

ability.name: Fragrance Trap

attacks.name: Triple Cannon

attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

attacks.name: Collapse

attacks.name: Firebreathing
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage plus 10 more damage; if tails, this attack does 10 damage.

attacks.name: Lava Burst
attacks.text: Discard the top 5 cards of your deck. (If there are fewer than 5 cards in your deck, discard all of them.) This attack does 20 damage for each Fire Energy card you discarded in this way.

attacks.name: Lucky Shot
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokemon and flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 damage to that Pokemon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokemon.) This attack can't be used if your opponent has no Benched Pokemon.

attacks.name: Spiral Dive
attacks.text: Does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Pokemon. Don't apply Weakness and Resistance.

attacks.name: Rock Toss
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Slam
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Tail Strike
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage plus 20 more damage; if tails, this attack does 10 damage.

ability.name: Strange Barrier

(Any other effects of attacks still happen.) This power stops working while Erika's Dratini is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Deflector
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, whenever Erika's Exeggcute takes damage, divide that damage in half (rounded down to the nearest 10). (Any other effects still happen.)

attacks.name: Egg Bomb

attacks.name: Psychic Exchange
attacks.text: Shuffle your hand into your deck, then draw 5 cards.

attacks.name: Stomp
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 damage plus 10 more damage; if tails, this attack does 30 damage.

attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, remove 4 damage counters from Erika's Gloom. If Erika's Gloom has fewer damage counters than that, remove all of them.

attacks.name: Magic Pollen
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokemon is now Asleep, Confused, Paralyzed, or Poisoned (your choice).

attacks.name: Dream Dance
attacks.text: Both the Defending Pokemon and Erika's Gloom are now Asleep (after doing damage).

attacks.name: Vile Smell
attacks.text: Both the Defending Pokemon and Erika's Gloom are now Confused (after doing damage).

attacks.name: Poisonpowder
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokemon is now Poisoned.

attacks.name: Flytrap
attacks.text: Before doing damage, choose 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokemon and switch it with his or her Active Pokemon. This attack can't be used if your opponent has no Benched Pokemon.

attacks.name: Sleep Poison
attacks.text: The Defending Pokemon is now Asleep and Poisoned.

attacks.name: Removal Pulse
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokemon has any Energy cards attached to it, flip a coin. If heads, choose 1 of those Energy cards and discard it.

attacks.name: Confusion Pulse
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokemon is now Confused.

attacks.name: Super Fang
attacks.text: Does damage to the Defending Pokemon equal to half the Defending Pokemon's remaining HP (rounded up to the nearest 10).

attacks.name: Rapids
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokemon has any Energy cards attached to it, flip a coin. If heads, choose 1 of those Energy cards and discard it.

attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, you may search your deck for a Basic Pokemon with Misty in its name and put it onto your Bench. (You can't use this attack if your Bench is full.) Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Mud Splash
attacks.text: If your opponent has any Benched Pokemon, choose 1 of them and flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage to that Pokemon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokemon.)

attacks.name: Water Gun
attacks.text: Does 10 damage plus 10 more damage for each Water Energy attached to Misty's Starmie but not used to pay for this attack's Energy cost. You can't add more than 20 damage in this way.

attacks.name: Bubblebeam
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokemon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Crystal Beam
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent can't attach Energy cards to the Defending Pokemon during his or her next turn.

attacks.name: Night Spirits
attacks.text: Flip a number of coins equal to the total number of Sabrina's Gastlys, Sabrina's Haunters, and Sabrina's Gengars you have in play. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Good Night
attacks.text: The Defending Pokemon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Good Morning
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokemon was Asleep, it is no longer Asleep.

attacks.name: Naptime
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, remove 3 damage counters from Sabrina's Slowbro and Sabrina's Slowbro is now Asleep. If Sabrina's Slowbro has fewer damage counters than that, remove all of them.

attacks.name: Screaming Headbutt
attacks.text: You can't use this attack during your next turn.

attacks.name: Kindle
attacks.text: Discard 1 Energy card attached to Blaine's Charmander in order to use this attack. If the Defending Pokemon has any Energy cards attached to it, choose 1 of them and discard it.

attacks.name: Blaze
attacks.text: Does 10 damage to each Grass Pokemon on your opponent's Bench. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokemon.)

attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to Blaine's Ponyta.

attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.text: Flip 4 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads to the Defending Pokemon and 20 damage times the number of tails to Blaine's Tauros.

attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, you may search your deck for a Basic Pokemon card with Brock in its name and put it onto your Bench. Shuffle your deck afterward. (You can't use this attack if your Bench is full.)

attacks.text: Don't apply Resistance for this attack. (Any other effects that would happen after applying Resistance still happen.)

attacks.text: If your opponent has any Benched Pokemon, choose 1 of them and switch it with the Defending Pokemon.

attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. If 1 or both of them are tails, this attack does nothing.

attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all damage done to Brock's Sandshrew during your opponent's next turn. (Any other effects of attacks still happen.)

attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage plus 20 more damage; if tails, this attack does 10 damage.

attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokemon is now Poisoned.

attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokemon is now Poisoned.

attacks.name: Eggsplosion
attacks.text: Flip a number of coins equal to the number of Energy attached to Erika's Exeggcute. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.text: Does 10 damage plus 10 more damage for each Energy card attached to the Defending Pokemon.

attacks.name: Blot
attacks.text: If there are any damage counters on Erika's Oddish, remove 1 of them.

attacks.text: If Erika's Oddish has any damage counters on it, flip a coin. If heads, remove 1 of those damage counters.

attacks.name: Lightning Tail
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokemon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.text: If your opponent has any Benched Pokemon, he or she chooses 1 of them and switches it with the Defending Pokemon. (Do the damage before switching the Pokemon.)

attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokemon is now Confused.

attacks.text: If the Defending Pokemon tries to attack during your opponent's next turn, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, that attack does nothing.

attacks.name: Hypnotic Stare
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokemon is now Paralyzed. If tails, the Defending Pokemon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Tail Rap
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Clamp
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokemon is now Paralyzed. If tails, this attack does nothing (not even damage).

attacks.name: Swift
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness, Resistance, Pokemon Powers, or any other effects on the Defending Pokemon.

attacks.name: Energy Loop
attacks.text: Return a Psychic Energy card attached to Sabrina's Abra to your hand in order to use this attack.

attacks.name: Suggestion

attacks.name: Spook
attacks.text: The Defending Pokemon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.text: Sabrina's Slowpoke is now Asleep (after doing damage).

attacks.text: If the Defending Pokemon has any Energy cards attached to it, flip a coin. If heads, choose 1 of those Energy cards and discard it.

cards.name: Blaine's Quiz #1
cards.text: Put a Basic Pokemon or Evolution card from your hand face down in front of you and tell your opponent its name. Your opponent guesses the length of that Pokemon. Flip the card over. If your opponent guessed right, he or she draws 2 cards. If your opponent guessed wrong, you draw 2 cards. Either way, return the card to your hand.

cards.name: Brock
cards.text: Remove 1 damage counter from each of your Pokemon that has any damage counters on it.

cards.name: Charity
cards.text: Attach Charity to your Active Pokemon. Unless that Pokemon gets Knocked Out, return Charity to your hand at the end of your turn. If that Pokemon attacks and does damage to the Defending Pokemon, you may reduce that damage by any amount (rounded to the nearest 10).

cards.name: Erika
cards.text: You may draw up to 3 cards, then your opponent may draw up to 3 cards.

cards.name: Lt. Surge
cards.text: You can play this card only if you have at least 1 Basic Pokemon card in your hand. Put a Basic Pokemon card from your hand into play as your Active Pokemon. Put your old Active Pokemon onto your Bench. (You can't play this card if your Bench is full.)

cards.name: Misty
cards.text: Discard 2 of the other cards in your hand in order to play this card. If this turn's attack does damage to the Defending Pokemon (after applying Weakness and Resistance), and if the attacking Pokemon has Misty in its name, the attack does 20 more damage to the Defending Pokemon.

cards.name: No Removal Gym
cards.text: This card stays in play when you play it. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play. A player must discard 2 cards from his or her hand in order to play an Energy Removal or Super Energy Removal card.

cards.name: The Rocket's Training Gym
cards.text: This card stays in play when you play it. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play. Each player pays Colorless more to retreat his or her Active Pokemon.

cards.name: Blaine's Last Resort
cards.text: You can't play this card if you have any cards in your hand other than Blaine's Last Resort. Show your hand to your opponent, then draw 5 cards.

cards.name: Brock's Training Method
cards.text: Search your deck for a Basic Pokemon or Evolution card with Brock in its name. Show that card to your opponent, then put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

cards.name: Celadon City Gym
cards.text: This card stays in play when you play it. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play. During each player's turn, that player may choose to discard an Energy card attached to 1 of his or her Pokemon with Erika in its name. If that player does so, that Pokemon is no longer Asleep, Confused, Paralyzed, or Poisoned.

cards.name: Cerulean City Gym
cards.text: This card stays in play when you play it. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play. Each player pays Colorless less to retreat his or her Pokemon if it has Misty in its name.

cards.name: Erika's Maids
cards.text: Trade 2 of the other cards in your hand for up to 2 Basic Pokemon and/or Evolution cards with Erika in their names from your deck. Show those cards to your opponent, then put them into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

cards.name: Erika's Perfume
cards.text: Look at your opponent's hand. If he or she has any Basic Pokemon cards there, you may put any number of them onto your opponent's Bench (as long as there's room).

cards.name: Good Manners
cards.text: In order to play this card, you can't have any Basic Pokemon cards in your hand. Show your hand to your opponent, then search your deck for a Basic Pokemon card, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

cards.name: Lt. Surge's Treaty
cards.text: Your opponent chooses 1 of the following: everyone chooses 1 of his or her own Prizes and put it into his or her hand, or you draw a card.

cards.name: Minion of Team Rocket
cards.text: Flip 2 coins. If both of them are heads, choose 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokemon and return it and all cards attached to it to his or her hand. If 1 or both of them are tails, your turn ends immediately (you can't attack this turn).

cards.name: Misty's Wrath
cards.text: Look at the top 7 cards of your deck. Choose 2 of those cards and put them into your hand. Discard the rest.

cards.name: Pewter City Gym
cards.text: This card stays in play when you play it. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play. Don't apply Resistance to any attacks made by Pokemon with Brock in their names.

cards.name: Recall
cards.text: For your attack this turn, your Active Pokemon can use any attack from its Basic Pokemon card or any Evolution card attached to it. (You still have to pay for that attack's Energy cost.)

cards.name: Sabrina's ESP
cards.text: Attach Sabrina's ESP to 1 of your Pokemon with Sabrina in its name. At the end of your turn, discard Sabrina's ESP. If that Pokemon uses and attack that involves flipping coins, Sabrina's ESP lets you re-flip those coins once. If you do, re-flip all the coins.

cards.name: Secret Mission
cards.text: Look at your opponent's hand. Then, you may discard as many other cards as you want from your hand and draw that many cards.

cards.name: Tickling Machine
cards.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent sets aside all the cards in his or her hand face down. Nobody may look at those cards. At the end of your opponent's next turn, your opponent puts those cards back into his or her hand. If tails, your turn ends immediately (you can't attack this turn).

cards.name: Vermilion City Gym
cards.text: This card stays in play when you play it. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play. Whenever a player attacks with a Pokemon with Lt. Surge in its name, he or she may flip a coin. If heads, and if that Pokemon's attack does damage to the Defending Pokemon (after applying Weakness and Resistance), that attack does 10 more damage to the Defending Pokemon. If tails, the attacking Pokemon does 10 damage to itself in addition to whatever its attack usually does.

cards.name: Blaine's Gamble
cards.text: Discard any number of other cards from your hand, then flip a coin. If heads, draw twice that many cards.

cards.name: Energy Flow
cards.text: For each of your Pokemon, you may return any number of Energy cards attached to it to your hand.

cards.name: Misty's Duel
cards.text: You and your opponent play a game of Rock-Paper-Scissors. The winner shuffles his or her hand into his or her deck and draws a new hand of 5 cards. (If you don't know how to play Rock-Paper-Scissors, flip a coin to decide who's the winner.)

cards.name: Narrow Gym
cards.text: This card stays in play when you play it. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play. No player may have more than 4 Pokemon on his or her Bench. When this card is played, if a player has 5 Pokemon on his or her Bench, that player chooses 1 of them and returns it and all cards attached to it to his or her hand. (If both players have to return a Pokemon, your opponent returns a Pokemon first.)

cards.name: Sabrina's Gaze
cards.text: Each player shuffles his or her hand into his or her deck and draws a new hand of the same number of cards.

cards.name: Trash Exchange
cards.text: Count the number of cards in your discard pile and shuffle them into your deck. Then discard that many cards from the top of your deck.

attacks.name: Heat Tackle
attacks.text: Blaine's Arcanine does 10 damage to itself.

attacks.name: Firestorm
attacks.text: Discard 3 Fire Energy cards attached to Blaine's Arcanine in order to use this attack.

attacks.name: Roaring Flames
attacks.text: Discard all Fire Energy cards attached to Blaine's Charizard. If all Energy cards attached to Blaine's Charizard provide 2 Fire Energy, discard all of them. This attack does 20 damage plus 20 more damage for each Fire Energy discarded in this way.

attacks.name: Flame Jet
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, choose 1 of your opponent's Pokemon. This attack does 40 damage to that Pokemon. Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for this attack. (Any other effects that would happen after applying Weakness and Resistance still happen.)

ability.name: Shapeshift
ability.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may attach an Evolution card from your hand to Brock's Ninetales. (This doesn't count as evolving Brock's Ninetales.) Treat Brock's Ninetales as if it were that Pokemon instead. It can't evolve, devolve, or use the Pokemon Power of that Pokemon. During your turn, you may discard the Evolution card attached to Brock's Ninetales. This power can't be used if Brock's Ninetales is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed. If Brock's Ninetales becomes Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed, discard all Evolution cards attached to it.

attacks.name: Growth
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, you may attach up to 2 Grass Energy cards from your hand to Erika's Venusaur.

attacks.name: Wide Solarbeam
attacks.text: If your opponent has any Benched Pokemon, choose 2 of them (or 1 if he or she only has 1). This attack does 20 damage to each of them. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokemon.)

attacks.name: Summon Storm
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. If both of them are heads, this attack does 20 damage to each other Pokemon (even your own). Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for this attack.

attacks.name: Dragon Tornado
attacks.text: Unless this attack Knocks Out the Defending Pokemon, choose 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokemon and switch it with the Defending Pokemon.

attacks.name: Hurricane Punch
attacks.text: Flip 4 coins. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads.

ability.name: Fortitude
ability.text: If Giovanni's Machamp would be Knocked Out by an opponent's attack, flip a coin. If heads, Giovanni's Machamp is not Knocked Out and its remaining HP become 10 instead. This power can't be used if Giovanni's Machamp is already Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Intimidate
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokemon's maximum HP is 50 or less, it can't attack Giovanni's Nidoking during your opponent's next turn. (Benching or evolving either Pokemon ends this effect.)

attacks.name: Tumbling Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 40 damage plus 30 more damage; if tails, this attack does 40 damage.

attacks.name: Ambush
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 damage plus 20 more damage; if tails, this attack does 20 damage.

ability.name: Call the Boss
ability.text: When you play Giovanni's Persian from your hand, you may search your deck for the Trainer card named Giovanni, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Nerve Poison
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokemon is now Paralyzed and Poisoned.

attacks.name: Hyper Needle
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing. Either way, you can't use this attack again as long as Koga's Beedrill stays in play (even putting Koga's Beedrill on the Bench won't let you use it again).

attacks.name: Giant Growth
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, Koga's Ditto's maximum HP is now 80 and Koga's Ditto's Pound attack's base damage is 30 instead of 10. (Benching Koga's Ditto ends this effect.)

attacks.name: Kerzap
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 damage plus 30 more damage to the Defending Pokemon and discard all Lightning Energy cards attached to Lt. Surge's Raichu. If tails, this attack does 20 damage.

attacks.name: Thundertackle
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokemon is now Paralyzed. If tails, Lt. Surge's Raichu does 20 damage to itself.

attacks.name: Electro Beam
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, discard all Energy cards attached to Misty's Golduck.

attacks.name: Super Removal
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, choose 1 Energy card attached to each of your opponent's Pokemon that has any Energy cards and discard those Energy cards.

ability.name: Rebellion
ability.text: Whenever Misty's Gyarados attacks, flip 2 coins. If both of them are tails, that attack does nothing. Instead, shuffle Misty's Gyarados and all cards attached to it into your deck. (This power works even if Misty's Gyarados is Confused.)

attacks.name: Juxtapose
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, switch the number of damage counters on Rocket's Mewtwo with the number of damage counters on the Defending Pokemon (even if it would Knock Out either Pokemon). (It's okay if 1 of the Pokemon has no damage counters on it.)

attacks.name: Hypnoblast
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokemon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Plasma
attacks.text: If there are any Lightning Energy cards in your discard pile, attach 1 of them to Rocket's Zapdos.

attacks.name: Electroburn
attacks.text: Rocket's Zapdos does damage to itself equal to 10 times the number of Lightning Energy cards attached to it.

attacks.name: Mega Burn
attacks.text: You can't use this attack during your next turn.

ability.name: Psylink
ability.text: Sabrina's Alakazam always has a copy of every attack your Psychic Pokemon in play have (including their Energy costs and anything else required in order to use those attacks, such as discarding Energy cards). This power can't be used if Sabrina's Alakazam is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

cards.name: Blaine
cards.text: During this turn, instead of attaching your free Energy card, you may instead attach 2 Fire Energy cards to 1 of your Pokemon with Blaine in its name. (Playing additional copies of this card this turn has no effect.)

cards.name: Giovanni
cards.text: Choose 1 of your Pokemon in play with Giovanni in its name. For the rest of your turn, you may evolve that Pokemon even if you just played or evolved it this turn or if this is your first turn. This effect also applies to the Pokemon it evolves into.

cards.name: Koga
cards.text: If an attack from a Pokemon with Koga in its name does damage to a Defending Pokemon this turn, that Pokemon is then Poisoned.

cards.name: Sabrina
cards.text: Take all Energy cards attached to 1 of your Pokemon with Sabrina in its name and attach them to another 1 of your Pokemon with Sabrina in its name.

attacks.name: Burn Up
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, discard all Fire Energy cards attached to Blaine's Ninetales.

ability.name: Healing Fire
ability.text: Whenever you attach a Fire Energy card from your hand to Blaine's Ninetales, remove 1 damage counter from it, if it has any. This power stops working when Blaine's Ninetales is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Lie Low
attacks.text: All damage done to Brock's Dugtrio during your opponent's next turn is reduced by 20 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Earthdrill
attacks.text: This attack can't be used unless Brock's Dugtrio used its Lie Low attack last turn.

attacks.name: Love Lariat
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 50 damage plus 50 more damage if you have at least 1 Giovanni's Nidoking on your Bench. If tails, this attack does nothing.

attacks.name: Snapping Pincers
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage plus 10 more damage; if tails, this attack does 10 damage.

attacks.name: Overhead Toss
attacks.text: If you have any Benched Pokemon, flip a coin. If tails, choose 1 of your Benched Pokemon. This attack does 20 damage to that Pokemon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokemon.)

attacks.name: Poison Buildup
attacks.text: Koga's Arbok is now Poisoned.

attacks.name: Poison Power
attacks.text: If Koga's Arbok is Poisoned, this attack's base damage is 40 instead of 20 and the Defending Pokemon is now Poisoned.

ability.name: Energy Drain
ability.text: If an opponent's attack does damage to Koga's Muk (even if Koga's Muk is Knocked Out), flip a coin. If heads and if it has any, choose 1 Energy card attached to the attacking Pokemon and discard it. This power can't be used if Koga's Muk is already Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed when your opponent attacks.

attacks.name: Quick Turn
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Aerial Maneuvers
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage plus 30 more damage, and, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to Koga's Pidgeotto. If tails, this attack does 10 damage.

attacks.name: High Voltage
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent can't play Trainer cards during his or her next turn.

attacks.name: Thunder Flare
attacks.text: Does 30 damage plus 10 damage times the number of damage counters on Lt. Surge's Jolteon, then flip a coin. If tails, Lt. Surge's Jolteon does 30 damage to itself.

attacks.name: Dark Wave
attacks.text: All Pokemon Powers stop working until the end of your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Shadow Bind
attacks.text: The Defending Pokemon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Damage Shift
attacks.text: Move 1 damage counter from each of your Pokemon that has any on it to the Defending Pokemon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance.)

attacks.name: Water Spray
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 damage plus 20 more damage; if tails, this attack does 20 damage.

attacks.name: Bonfire
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. For each heads, discard 1 Fire Energy card attached to Blaine's Charmeleon. If you can't discard Energy cards, this attack does nothing. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads to each of your opponent's Pokemon. Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for this attack. (Any other effects that would happen after applying Weakness and Resistance still happen.)

attacks.name: Mega Peck
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

attacks.name: Stamp
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 damage plus 10 more damage (to the Defending Pokemon) and 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokemon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokemon.) If tails, this attack does 30 damage (to the Defending Pokemon).

attacks.name: Detonate
attacks.text: Does 10 damage to each Pokemon on each player's bench. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokemon.) Brock's Graveler does 50 damage to itself. If there is a Stadium card in play, discard it.

attacks.name: Mega Thrash
attacks.text: Brock's Primeape does 20 damage to itself. If there is a Stadium card in play, discard it.

ability.name: Scram
ability.text: If Brock's Primeape ever has exactly 10 HP left, shuffle it and all cards attached to it into your deck. This power stops working while Brock's Primeape is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Swift
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness, Resistance, Pokemon Powers, or any other effects on the Defending Pokemon.

attacks.name: Needle Ball
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokemon is now Poisoned.

attacks.name: Hypnotic Gaze
attacks.text: The Defending Pokemon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Fire Ring
attacks.text: If your opponent has any Benched Pokemon, choose 1 of them and this attack does 10 damage to it. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokemon.)

attacks.name: Stretch Vine
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokemon, and this attack does 10 damage to it. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokemon.)

ability.name: Soak Up
ability.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may take up to 2 Grass Energy cards attached to your other Pokemon and attach them to Erika's Bellsprout. This power can't be used if Erika's Bellsprout is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Sleep Seed
attacks.text: The Defending Pokemon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Errand-Running
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, you may search your deck for a Trainer card. Show it to your opponent and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Lunar Power
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for a card that evolves from 1 of your Benched Pokemon and put that card on that Pokemon. (This counts as evolving that Pokemon.) Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Double Razor Leaf
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 40 damage times the number of heads.

ability.name: Relaxing Scent
ability.text: As long as Erika's Ivysaur is your Active Pokemon, whenever an attack (even your own) does damage to any Pokemon (after applying Weakness and Resistance), that attack only does half the damage to that Pokemon (rounded up to the nearest 10). (Any other effects of attacks still happen.) This power stops working while Erika's Ivysaur is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Risky Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does no damage to the Defending Pokemon and Giovanni's Machoke does 100 damage to itself.

attacks.name: Headlock
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 damage plus 20 more damage and the Defending Pokemon is now Paralyzed. If tails, this attack does 20 damage.

attacks.name: False Charity
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, look at the top card of your opponent's deck. If it's a Trainer card, put it in your opponent's discard pile; otherwise, put it into his or her hand.

attacks.name: Double Scratch
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Poison Sting Tackle
attacks.text: Giovanni's Nidorina does 20 damage to itself. Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokemon is now Poisoned.

attacks.name: Body Slam
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokemon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Rend
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokemon already has any damage counters on it, this attack does 20 damage plus 20 more damage. If not, this attack does 20 damage.

attacks.name: Sonic Scream
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokemon is now Confused.

attacks.name: Toxic Secretion
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokemon is now Poisoned. It now takes 20 Poison damage instead of 10 after each player's turn (even if it was already Poisoned).

ability.name: Emerge
ability.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for an Evolution card named Koga's Beedrill and put it on Koga's Kakuna. (This counts as evolving Koga's Kakuna.) Shuffle your deck afterward. This power can't be used if Koga's Kakuna is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Smokescreen
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokemon tries to attack during your opponent's next turn, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, that attack does nothing.

attacks.name: Obscuring Gas
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, shuffle Koga's Koffing and all cards attached to it into your deck (after doing damage).

attacks.name: Messenger
attacks.text: Put Koga's Pidgey and all cards attached to it on top of your deck. Then search your deck for any Basic Pokemon or Evolution card not named Koga's Pidgey. Show that card to your opponent, then put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Spontaneous Explosion
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage plus 30 more damage and Koga's Weezing does 30 damage to itself; if tails, this attack does 10 damage.

attacks.name: Toxic Cloud
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokemon is now Poisoned. It now takes 20 Poison damage instead of 10 after each player's turn (even if it was already Poisoned).

attacks.name: Surprise
attacks.text: Look at a random card from your opponent's hand. Your opponent shuffles that card into his or her deck.

attacks.name: Power Ball
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 30 damage plus 10 more damage for each heads.

ability.name: Shock Blast
ability.text: If Lt. Surge's Electrode is your Active Pokemon and gets damaged (even if it's Knocked Out), flip a coin. If tails, this power does 20 damage to each Active Pokemon. This power works even if Lt. Surge's Electrode is already Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed when it takes damage.

attacks.name: Focus Energy
attacks.text: During your next turn, Lt. Surge's Raticate's Double-edge attack's damage (base damage and damage to itself) is doubled.

attacks.name: Double-edge
attacks.text: Lt. Surge's Raticate does 20 damage to itself.

attacks.name: Ice Throw
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokemon is Fighting, this attack's base damage is doubled.

attacks.name: Take Down
attacks.text: Misty's Dewgong does 20 damage to itself.

attacks.name: Nightmare
attacks.text: The Defending Pokemon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Shadow Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, and if your opponent has any Benched Pokemon, choose 1 of them and this attack does 30 damage to it. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokemon.)

attacks.name: Invigorate
attacks.text: Choose 1 Basic Pokemon in any player's discard pile. Put it onto that player's Bench. Put a number of damage counters on that Pokemon equal to half its HP (rounded down to the nearest 10). (You can't put a Pokemon on a Bench that's full.)

attacks.name: Pendulum Curse
attacks.text: Flip a number of coins equal to the number of damage counters on the Defending Pokemon. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Helping Hand
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokemon. Remove any number of damage counters from that Pokemon, then draw that many cards.

attacks.name: Hug
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokemon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Life Drain
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, put a number of damage counters on the Defending Pokemon so that its remaining HP are 10.

attacks.name: Magic Darts
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokemon and flip 3 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads to that Pokemon. Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for this attack.

attacks.name: Fire Tail Slap
attacks.text: Use this attack only if there are any Fire Energy cards attached to Blaine's Charmander. Flip a coin. If tails, discard 1 of those cards.

attacks.name: Wild Kick
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

attacks.name: Retaliate
attacks.text: Does 10 damage times the number of damage counters on Blaine's Doduo.

attacks.name: Stoke
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Fire Energy card and attach it to Blaine's Growlithe. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Body Slam
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokemon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Pranks
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, choose a card from your opponent's discard pile and put it on top of his or her deck.

attacks.name: Fury Swipes
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Hind Kick
attacks.text: If you have any Benched Pokemon, flip a coin. If heads, switch Blaine's Ponyta with 1 of your Benched Pokemon.

attacks.name: Horn Charge
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

attacks.name: Overrun
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads and if your opponent has any Benched Pokemon, choose 1 of them and this attack does 20 damage to it. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokemon.)

attacks.name: Call Will-o'-the-wisp
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. For each heads, if you have a Fire Energy card in your discard pile, put it into your hand.

attacks.name: Surprise Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

attacks.name: Tremor
attacks.text: Does 10 damage to each of your own Benched Pokemon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokemon.)

attacks.name: Rock Toss
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Group Therapy
attacks.text: You and your opponent remove 1 damage counter from each of your Pokemon with damage counters on them.

attacks.name: Pulled Punch
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokemon has no damage counters on it, this attack does 40 damage. If it has any damage counters on it, this attack does 10 damage.

attacks.name: Strange Powder
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokemon is now Confused; if tails, the Defending Pokemon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Poison Spore
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokemon is now Poisoned and this attack does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokemon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokemon.)

attacks.name: Fury Punch
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 damage times the number of damage counters on Giovanni's Machop.

attacks.name: Ancestral Memory
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing. Either way, you can't use this attack again as long as Giovanni's Magikarp stays in play (even putting Giovanni's Magikarp on the Bench won't let you use it again).

attacks.name: Flail Around
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Cat Fleas
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokemon is now Confused.

attacks.name: Horn Thrust
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

attacks.name: Double-edge
attacks.text: Giovanni's Nidoran F does 20 damage to itself.

attacks.name: Double Kick
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Retaliation
attacks.text: You can't use this attack unless Giovanni's Nidoran M has 2 or more damage counters on it.

attacks.name: Fast-Acting Poison
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. If both are heads, the Defending Pokemon is now Confused and Poisoned.

attacks.name: Sludge Grip
attacks.text: If your opponent has any Benched Pokemon, flip a coin. If heads, choose 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokemon and switch it with the Defending Pokemon. The new Defending Pokemon is now Poisoned.

attacks.name: Smelly Gas
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage to each Benched Pokemon (including your own). (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokemon.)

attacks.name: Sand-attack
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokemon tries to attack during your opponent's next turn, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, that attack does nothing.

attacks.name: Sleep Powder
attacks.text: The Defending Pokemon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Grasping Vine
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, draw 2 cards.

attacks.name: Sharp Stinger
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokemon is now Poisoned; if tails, the Defending Pokemon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Group Attack
attacks.text: Does 10 damage times the number of Koga's Zubats you have in play. Before doing damage, you may search your deck for any number of Basic Pokemon named Koga's Zubat and put them onto your Bench. (You can't get more cards with this attack than you have room on your Bench.) If you do, shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Quick Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage plus 20 more damage; if tails, this attack does 10 damage.

attacks.name: Focus Energy
attacks.text: During your next turn, Lt. Surge's Rattata's Quick Attack's base damage is doubled.

attacks.name: Quick Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage plus 20 more damage; if tails, this attack does 10 damage.

attacks.name: Bouncing Ball
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, Lt. Surge's Voltorb does 10 damage to itself.

attacks.name: Ink Spurt
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, whenever the Defending Pokemon tries to attack, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, that attack does nothing. (This effect lasts until the Defending Pokemon evolves or is Benched.)

attacks.name: Play Dead
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to Misty's Magikarp.

attacks.name: Bubbles
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, you can't use this attack during your next turn.

attacks.name: Amnesia
attacks.text: Choose 1 of the Defending Pokemon's attacks. That Pokemon can't use that attack during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: ESP
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. If exactly 1 is heads, draw a card. If exactly 2 are heads, this attack does 20 damage. If all 3 are heads, choose 1 of the Defending Pokemon's attacks. Misty's Psyduck copies that attack except for its Energy costs. (No matter what type the Defending Pokemon is, Misty's Psyduck's type is still Water.)

attacks.name: Frostbite
attacks.text: The Defending Pokemon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Mirage
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokemon tries to attack during your opponent's next turn, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, that attack does nothing.

attacks.name: Star Boomerang
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, return Misty's Staryu and all cards attached to it to your hand. (Either way, this attack does its damage.)

attacks.name: Synchronize
attacks.text: This attack can't be used unless Sabrina's Abra and the Defending Pokemon have the same number of Energy cards attached to them.

attacks.name: Psyscan
attacks.text: Look at your opponent's hand.

attacks.name: Quick Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage plus 20 more damage; if tails, this attack does 10 damage.

attacks.name: Energy Support
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Psychic Energy card. Show that card to your opponent, then put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Mind Shock
attacks.text: Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for this attack. (Any other effects that would happen after applying Weakness and Resistance still happen.)

attacks.name: Lick
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokemon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Fade Out
attacks.text: Return Sabrina's Gastly and all Energy cards attached to it to your hand. (Discard all other cards attached to Sabrina's Gastly.)

ability.name: Gaseous Form
ability.text: Sabrina's Gastly gets +10 HP for each Psychic Energy card attached to it. This power works even if Sabrina's Gastly is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Barrier Attack
attacks.text: All damage done by attacks to Sabrina's Porygon during your opponent's next turn is reduced by 10 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Random ESP
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokemon is now Confused. If tails, this attack does no damage and Sabrina's Psyduck is now Confused.

cards.name: Blaine
cards.text: During this turn, instead of attaching your free Energy card, you may instead attach 2 Fire Energy cards to 1 of your Pokemon with Blaine in its name. (Playing additional copies of this card this turn has no effect.)

cards.name: Brock's Protection
cards.text: Attach Brock's Protection to 1 of your Pokemon with Brock in its name. Energy cards attached to that Pokemon can't be removed by your opponent's attacks or Trainer cards. (This doesn't stop the rest of the attack or Trainer card from working normally.)

cards.name: Chaos Gym
cards.text: This card stays in play after being played. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play. Whenever a player plays a Trainer card other than a Stadium card, he or she flips a coin. If heads, that player plays that card normally. If tails, the player can't play that card. If the card isn't put into play, the player's opponent may use that card instead, if he or she does everything required in order to play that card (like discarding cards). Either way, the card goes to its owner's discard pile.

cards.name: Erika's Kindness
cards.text: Remove 2 damage counters from each Pokemon (yours and your opponent's) with any damage counters on it. If a Pokemon has just 1 damage counter, remove it.

cards.name: Giovanni
cards.text: Choose 1 of your Pokemon in play with Giovanni in its name. For the rest of your turn, you may evolve that Pokemon even if you just played or evolved it this turn or if this is your first turn. This effect also applies to the Pokemon it evolves into.

cards.name: Giovanni's Last Resort
cards.text: Remove all damage counters from 1 of your Pokemon with Giovanni in its name. Then discard your hand.

cards.name: Koga
cards.text: If an attack from a Pokemon with Koga in its name does damage to a Defending Pokemon this turn, that Pokemon is then Poisoned.

cards.name: Lt. Surge's Secret Plan
cards.text: Put 1 card from your hand face down onto your Bench. (You can't play this card if your Bench is full.) Treat that card as a Basic Pokemon as long as it's face down. Flip the card if either player needs to know what it is in order to use an attack, a Pokemon Power, or a Trainer card. Flip the card if it ever uses an attack or Pokemon Power, evolves, retreats, is damaged by an attack, or is otherwise affected by an attack. At any time during your turn, you may flip the card over. When you flip that card over, if it isn't a Basic Pokemon, discard it and all cards attached to it.

cards.name: Misty's Wish
cards.text: Look at 1 of your Prize cards. Then, ask your opponent if you may switch that card with 1 of the cards in your hand. If your opponent accepts and if you have any other cards in your hand, switch those cards. If your opponent declines, return the Prize card face down and draw a card.

cards.name: Resistance Gym
cards.text: This card stays in play after being played. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play. Each Pokemon's Resistance is reduced by 20. (If a Pokemon's Resistance is -30, it becomes -10.)

cards.name: Sabrina
cards.text: Take all Energy cards attached to 1 of your Pokemon with Sabrina in its name and attach them to another 1 of your Pokemon with Sabrina in its name.

cards.name: Blaine's Quiz #2
cards.text: Put a card from your hand face down in front of you. Your opponent guesses whether it is an Energy card, a Trainer card, or a Pokemon (Basic or Evolution) card. Flip the card over. If your opponent guessed right, he or she draws 2 cards. If your opponent guessed wrong, you draw 2 cards. Either way, return the card to your hand.

cards.name: Blaine's Quiz #3
cards.text: Put a Basic or Evolution card from your hand face down in front of you and tell your opponent the name of an attack of that card. Your opponent guesses the name of that card. Flip the card over. If your opponent guessed right, he or she draws 3 cards. If your opponent guessed wrong, you draw 3 cards. Either way, return the card to your hand.

cards.name: Cinnabar City Gym
cards.text: This card stays in play after being played. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play. Ignore Weakness when a Water Pokemon does damage to a Pokemon with Blaine in its name.

cards.name: Fuchsia City Gym
cards.text: This card stays in play after being played. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play. Once during each player's turn (before attacking), that player may flip a coin. If heads, that player may shuffle 1 of his or her Pokemon in play with Koga in its name and any cards attached to it into his or her deck.

cards.name: Koga's Ninja Trick
cards.text: Attach Koga's Ninja Trick to your Active Pokemon with Koga in its name. If this Pokemon goes to your Bench, discard this card. When your opponent attacks, you may switch this Pokemon with 1 of your Benched Pokemon (before damage or other effects of attacks).

cards.name: Master Ball
cards.text: Look at 7 cards from the top of your deck. You may choose a Basic Pokemon or Evolution card from those cards, show it to your opponent, then put it into your hand. Shuffle the rest into your deck.

cards.name: Max Revive
cards.text: Discard 2 Energy cards from your hand in order to put 1 Basic Pokemon from your discard pile onto your Bench. (You can't play Max Revive if your Bench is full.)

cards.name: Misty's Tears
cards.text: Discard 1 of the other cards in your hand in order to search your deck for up to 2 Water Energy cards. Show those cards to your opponent, then put them into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

cards.name: Rocket's Minefield Gym
cards.text: This card stays in play after being played. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play. Whenever a player puts a Basic Pokemon onto his or her Bench from his or her hand, he or she flips a coin. If tails, put damage counters on that Pokemon.

cards.name: Rocket's Secret Experiment
cards.text: Flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for any card and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward. If tails, you can't play Trainer cards until the end of your next turn.

cards.name: Sabrina's Psychic Control
cards.text: Flip a coin. If heads, choose a Trainer card in your opponent's discard pile that isn't put in play (like PlusPower or Mysterious Fossil). You may use that card as if it were in your hand, if you do everything required in order to play that card (like discarding cards). The card stays in your opponent's discard pile.

cards.name: Saffron City Gym
cards.text: This card stays in play after being played. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play. As often as each player like during his or her turn (before attacking), that player may return 1 basic Energy card attached to 1 of his or her Pokemon with Sabrina in its name to his or her hand.

cards.name: Viridian City Gym
cards.text: This card stays in play after being played. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play. Whenever a Pokemon with Giovanni in its name evolves, its owner removes 2 damage counters from that Pokemon (or 1 if it only has 1).

cards.name: Fervor
cards.text: Show the top 3 cards of your deck to all players. Put any Fire Energy cards there into your hand and discard the rest.

cards.name: Transparent Walls
cards.text: Until the end of your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from attacks done to your Benched Pokemon. (Any other effects of attacks still happen.)

cards.name: Warp Point
cards.text: If your opponent has any Benched Pokemon, he or she chooses 1 of them and switches it with his or her Active Pokemon, then, if you have any Benched Pokemon, you switch 1 of them with your Active Pokemon.

cards.name: Ampharos
cards.flavor: The tail's tip shines brightly and can be seen from far away. It acts as a beacon for lost people.

attacks.name: Gigaspark
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokemon is now Paralyzed and this attack does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokemon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokemon.)

cards.name: Azumarill
cards.flavor: By keeping still and listening intently, it can tell what is in even wild, fast-moving rivers.

attacks.name: Bubble Shower
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokemon is now Paralyzed and this attack does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokemon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokemon.)

cards.name: Bellossom
cards.flavor: Plentiful in the tropics. When it dances, its petals rub together and make a pleasant ringing sound.

attacks.name: Sweet Nectar
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, remove all damage counters from 1 of your Pokemon.

attacks.name: Flower Dance
attacks.text: Does 30 damage times the number of cards with Bellossom in their names that you have in play (including this one).

cards.name: Feraligatr
cards.flavor: When it bites with its massive and powerful jaws, it shakes its head and savagely tears its victim up.

attacks.name: Chomp
attacks.text: Flip a number of coins equal to the number of damage counters on Feraligatr. This attack does 50 damage plus 10 more damage for each heads.

ability.name: Berserk
ability.text: When you play Feraligatr from your hand, flip a coin. If heads, discard the top 5 cards from your opponent's deck. If tails, discard the top 5 cards from your deck.

cards.name: Feraligatr
cards.flavor: It is hard for it to support its own weight out of water, so it gets down on all fours. But it moves fast.

attacks.name: Riptide
attacks.text: Does 10 damage plus 10 damage times the number of Water Energy cards in your discard pile. Then, shuffle all Water Energy cards from your discard pile into your deck.

ability.name: Downpour
ability.text: As often as you like during your turn (before your attack), you may discard a Water Energy card from your hand. This power can't be used if Feraligatr is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

cards.name: Heracross
cards.flavor: This powerful Pokemon thrusts its prized horn under its enemies' bellies, then lifts and throws them.

attacks.name: Megahorn
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

ability.name: Final Blow
ability.text: If Heracross's remaining HP are 20 or less, you may make its Megahorn attack's base damage 120 instead of 60. This power can't be used if Heracross is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

cards.name: Jumpluff
cards.flavor: Once it catches the wind, it deftly controls its cotton-puff spores to float, even around the world.

attacks.name: Sleep Powder
attacks.text: The Defending Pokemon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Leech Seed
attacks.text: If this attack damages the Defending Pokemon (after applying Weakness and Resistance), remove 1 damage counter from Jumpluff, if it has any.

cards.name: Kingdra
cards.flavor: It is said that it usually hides in underwater caves. It can create whirlpools by yawning.

attacks.name: Agility
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to Kingdra.

attacks.name: Dragon Tornado
attacks.text: If this attack doesn't Knock Out the Defending Pokemon, and if there are any Pokemon on your opponent's Bench, choose 1 of them and switch it with the Defending Pokemon.

cards.name: Lugia
cards.flavor: It is said that it quietly spends its time deep at the bottom of the sea, because its powers are too strong.

attacks.name: Elemental Blast
attacks.text: Discard a Fire Energy card, a Water Energy card, and a Lightning Energy card attached to Lugia in order to use this attack.

cards.name: Meganium
cards.flavor: Meganium's breath has the power to revive dead grass and plants. It can make them healthy again.

attacks.name: Body Slam
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokemon is now Paralyzed.

ability.name: Herbal Scent
ability.text: When you play Meganium from your hand, you may flip a coin. If heads, remove all damage counters from all Grass Pokemon in play.

cards.name: Meganium
cards.flavor: The aroma that rises from its petals contains a substance that calms aggressive feelings.

attacks.name: Soothing Scent
attacks.text: The Defending Pokemon is now Asleep.

ability.name: Wild Growth
ability.text: As long as Meganium is in play each Grass Energy card attached to your Grass Pokemon instead provides GrassGrass. This power stops working while Meganium is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

cards.name: Pichu
cards.flavor: Despite its small size, it can zap even adult humans. However, if it does so, it also surprises itself.

attacks.name: Zzzap
attacks.text: Does 20 damage to each Pokemon in play that has a Pokemon Power. Don't apply Weakness and Resistance.

cards.name: Skarmory
cards.flavor: Its sturdy wings look heavy, but they are actually hollow and light, allowing it to fly freely in the sky.

attacks.name: Claw
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

attacks.name: Steel Wing
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, all damage done by attacks to Skarmory during your opponent's next turn is reduced by 20 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.name: Slowking
cards.flavor: When its head was bitten, toxins entered Slowpoke's head and unlocked an extraordinary power.

attacks.name: Mind Blast
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 damage plus 10 more damage and the Defending Pokemon is now Confused. If tails, this attack does 20 damage.

ability.name: Mind Games
ability.text: Whenever your opponent plays a Trainer card, you may flip a coin. If heads, that card does nothing. Put it on top of your opponent's deck. This power can't be used if Slowking is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

cards.name: Steelix
cards.flavor: Its body has been compressed deep under the ground. As a result, it is even harder than a diamond.

attacks.name: Tail Crush
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 damage plus 20 more damage; if tails, this attack does 30 damage.

cards.name: Togetic
cards.flavor: They say that it will appear before kindhearted, caring people and shower them with happiness.

attacks.name: Super Metronome
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, choose an attack on 1 of your opponent's Pokemon. Super Metronome copies that attack except for its Energy cost. (You must still do anything else in order to use that attack.) (No matter what type the Defending Pokemon is, Togetic's type is still Colorless.) Togetic performs that attack. (Togetic can make that attack even if it does not have the appropriate number or type of Energy attached to it necessary to make the attack.)

attacks.name: Fly
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to Togetic; if tails, this attack does nothing (not even damage).

cards.name: Typhlosion
cards.flavor: If its rage peaks, it becomes so hot that anything that touches it will instantly go up in flames.

attacks.name: Flame Burst
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 60 damage plus 20 more damage and does 20 damage to Typhlosion. If tails, this attack does 60 damage.

ability.name: Fire Recharge
ability.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may flip a coin. If heads, attach a Fire Energy card from your discard pile to 1 of your Fire Pokemon. This power can't be used if Typhlosion is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

cards.name: Typhlosion
cards.flavor: It has a secret, devastating move. It rubs its blazing fur together to cause huge explosions.

attacks.name: Flame Wheel
attacks.text: Discard 3 Fire Energy cards attached to Typhlosion in order to use this attack. Do 20 damage to each Benched Pokemon (yours and your opponent's). (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokemon.)

ability.name: Fire Boost
ability.text: When you play Typhlosion from your hand, you may flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for up to 4 Fire Energy cards and attach them to Typhlosion. Shuffle your deck afterward.

cards.name: Metal Energy
cards.text: Damage done to the Pokemon Metal Energy is attached to is reduced by 10 (after applying Weakness and Resistance). If the Pokemon Metal Energy is attached to isn't Metal, whenever it damages a Pokemon, reduce that damage by 10 (before applying Weakness and Resistance). Metal Energy provides Metal Energy. (Doesn't count as a basic Energy card.)

cards.name: Cleffa
cards.flavor: Because of its unusual, star-like silhouette, people believe that it came here on a meteor.

attacks.name: Eeeeeeek
attacks.text: Shuffle your hand into your deck, then draw 7 cards.

cards.name: Donphan
cards.flavor: It has sharp, hard tusks and a rugged hide. Its tackle is strong enough to knock down a house.

attacks.name: Flail
attacks.text: Does 10 damage times the number of damage counters on Donphan.

attacks.name: Rapid Spin
attacks.text: If your opponent has any Benched Pokemon, he or she chooses 1 of them and switches it with his or her Active Pokemon, then, if you have any Benched Pokemon, you switch 1 of them with your Active Pokemon. (Do the damage before switching the Pokemon.)

cards.name: Elekid
cards.flavor: It rotates its arms to generate electricity, but it tires easily, so it charges up only a little bit.

ability.name: Playful Punch
ability.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may flip a coin. If heads, do 20 damage to your opponent's Active Pokemon. (Apply Weakness and Resistance.) Either way, this ends your turn. This power can't be used if Elekid is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

cards.name: Magby
cards.flavor: Each and every time it inhales and exhales, hot embers dribble out of its mouth and nostrils.

attacks.name: Sputter
attacks.text: All Pokemon Powers stop working until the end of your next turn.

cards.name: Murkrow
cards.flavor: It is said that when chased, it lures its attacker onto dark mountain trails where the foe will get lost.

attacks.name: Mean Look
attacks.text: The Defending Pokemon can't retreat as long as Murkrow remains your Active Pokemon. (Benching or evolving either Pokemon ends this effect.)

attacks.name: Feint Attack
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokemon. This attack does 20 damage to that Pokemon. This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness, Resistance, Pokemon Powers, or any other effects on the Defending Pokemon.

cards.name: Sneasel
cards.flavor: Its paws conceal sharp claws. If attacked, it suddenly extends the claws and startles its enemy.

attacks.name: Fury Swipes
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Beat Up
attacks.text: Flip a coin for each of your Pokemon in play (including this one). This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.

cards.name: Aipom
cards.flavor: Its tail is so powerful that it can use it to grab a tree branch and hold itself up in the air.

attacks.name: Pilfer
attacks.text: Shuffle Aipom and all cards attached to it into your deck. Flip a coin. If heads, shuffle a card from your discard pile into your deck.

attacks.name: Tail Rap
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

cards.name: Ariados
cards.flavor: It spins string not only from its rear but also from its mouth. It's hard to tell which end is which.

attacks.name: Spider Web
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokemon can't retreat. (Benching or evolving that Pokemon ends this effect.)

attacks.name: Poison Bite
attacks.text: If this attack damages the Defending Pokemon, the Defending Pokemon is now Poisoned and you remove a number of damage counters from Ariados equal to half that damage (rounded up to the nearest 10). If Ariados has fewer damage counters than that, remove all of them.

cards.name: Bayleef
cards.flavor: A spicy aroma emanates from around its neck. The aroma acts as a stimulant to restore health.

attacks.name: Poisonpowder
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokemon is now Poisoned.

attacks.name: Pollen Shield
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, Bayleef can't become Asleep, Confused, Paralyzed, or Poisoned. (All other effects of attacks, Pokemon Powers and Trainer cards still happen.)

cards.name: Bayleef
cards.flavor: The scent of spices comes from around its neck. Somehow, sniffing it makes you want to fight.

attacks.name: Sweet Scent
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads and if any of your Pokemon have any damage counters on them, then remove 2 damage counters from 1 of them (or 1 if it only has 1). If tails and if any of your opponent's Pokemon have any damage counters on them, choose 1 of them and remove 2 damage counters from it (or 1 if it only has 1).

attacks.name: Double Razor Leaf
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 40 damage times the number of heads.

cards.name: Clefairy
cards.flavor: The moonlight that it stores in the wings on its back apparently gives it the ability to float in midair.

attacks.name: Doubleslap
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Squaredance
attacks.text: Flip a number of coins equal to the total number of Pokemon in play. For each heads, you may search your deck for a basic Energy card, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

cards.name: Croconaw
cards.flavor: If it loses a fang, a new one grows back in its place. There are always 48 fangs lining its mouth.

attacks.name: Screech
attacks.text: Until the end of your next turn, if an attack damages the Defending Pokemon (after applying Weakness and Resistance), that attack does 20 more damage to the Defending Pokemon

attacks.name: Jaw Clamp
attacks.text: Until the end of your opponent's next turn, as long as Croconaw is your Active Pokemon, the Defending Pokemon can't retreat, and if the effect of an attack, Pokemon Power, or Trainer card would change that player's Active Pokemon, that part of the effect does nothing.

cards.name: Croconaw
cards.flavor: It opens its huge jaws wide when attacking. If it loses any fangs while biting, they grow back in.

attacks.name: Sweep Away
attacks.text: Discard the top 3 cards from your deck.

cards.name: Electabuzz
cards.flavor: Electricity runs across the surface of its body. In darkness, its entire body glows a whitish-blue.

attacks.name: Swift
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness, Resistance, Pokemon Powers, or any other effects on the Defending Pokemon.

cards.name: Flaaffy
cards.flavor: As a result of storing too much electricity, it developed patches where even downy wool won't grow.

attacks.name: Discharge
attacks.text: Discard all Lightning Energy cards attached to Flaaffy in order to use this attack. Flip a number of coins equal to the number of Lightning Energy cards you discarded. This attack does 30 damage times then number of heads.

attacks.name: Electric Current
attacks.text: Take 1 Lightning Energy cards attached to Flaaffy and attach it to 1 of your Benched Pokemon. If you have no Benched Pokemon, discard that Energy card.

cards.name: Furret
cards.flavor: It makes a nest to suit its long and skinny body. The nest is impossible for other Pokemon to enter.

attacks.name: Quick Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 damage plus 10 more damage; if tails, this attack does 20 damage.

attacks.name: Slam
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads.

cards.name: Gloom
cards.flavor: What appears to be drool is actually sweet honey. It is very sticky and clings stubbornly if touched.

attacks.name: Strange Powder
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokemon is now Confused. If tails, the Defending Pokemon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Sticky Nectar
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 damage plus 10 more damage and, until the end of your next turn, as long as Gloom is your Active Pokemon, the Defending Pokemon can't retreat, and if the effect of an attack, Pokemon Power, or Trainer card would change that player's Active Pokemon, that part of the effect does nothing. If tails, this attack does 20 damage.

cards.name: Granbull
cards.flavor: It is actually timid and easily spooked. If attacked, it flails about to fend off its attacker.

attacks.name: Raging Charge
attacks.text: This attack does 10 damage plus 10 more damage for each damage counter on Granbull. Then, Granbull does 20 damage to itself.

cards.name: Lanturn
cards.flavor: The light it emits is so bright that it can illuminate the sea's surface from a depth of over three miles.

attacks.name: Floodlight
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokemon is now Paralyzed.

ability.name: Hydroelectric Power
ability.text: You may make Floodlight do 10 more damage for each Water Energy attached to Lanturn, but not used to pay for Floodlight's Energy cost. This power can't be used if Lanturn is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

cards.name: Ledian
cards.flavor: When the stars flicker in the night sky, Ledian flutters about, scattering a glowing powder.

attacks.name: Baton Pass
attacks.text: If you have any Grass Pokemon on your Bench, remove all Grass Energy cards from Ledian and attach them to 1 of those Pokemon, then switch Ledian with that Pokemon.

cards.name: Magmar
cards.flavor: It dislikes cold places, so it blows scorching flames to make the environment suitable for itself.

cards.name: Miltank
cards.flavor: Its milk is packed with nutrition, making it the ultimate beverage for the sick or weary.

attacks.name: Milk Drink
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. Remove 2 damage counters times the number of heads from Miltank. If it has fewer damage counters than that, remove all of them.

attacks.name: Body Slam
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokemon is now Paralyzed.

cards.name: Noctowl
cards.flavor: Its eyes are specially adapted. They concentrate even faint light and enable it to see in the dark.

ability.name: Glaring Gaze
ability.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may flip a coin. If heads, look at your opponent's hand. If your opponent has any Trainer cards there, choose 1 of them. Your opponent shuffles that card into his or her deck. This power can't be used if Noctowl is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

cards.name: Phanpy
cards.flavor: It swings its long snout around playfully, but, because it is so strong, that can be dangerous.

attacks.name: Endure
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, then if, during your opponent's next turn, Phanpy would be Knocked Out by an attack, Phanpy isn't Knocked Out and its remaining HP become 10 instead.

cards.name: Piloswine
cards.flavor: Because the long hair all over its body obscures its sight, it just keeps charging repeatedly.

attacks.name: Freeze
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokemon can't attack. (Benching or evolving the Defending Pokemon ends this effect.)

attacks.name: Blizzard
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokemon; if tails, this attack does 10 damage to each of your own Benched Pokemon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokemon.)

cards.name: Quagsire
cards.flavor: Due to its relaxed and carefree attitude, it often bumps its head on boulders and boat hulls as it swims.

attacks.name: Earthquake
attacks.text: Does 10 damage to each of your own Benched Pokemon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokemon.)

cards.name: Quilava
cards.flavor: This Pokemon is fully covered by nonflammable fur. It can withstand any kind of fire attack.

attacks.name: Ember
attacks.text: Discard 1 Fire Energy card attached to Quilava in order to use this attack.

attacks.name: Fire Wind
attacks.text: If your opponent has any Benched Pokemon, choose 1 of them. Flip 2 coins. For each heads, this attack does 10 damage to that Pokemon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance.)

cards.name: Quilava
cards.flavor: Be careful if it turns its back during battle. It means that it will attack with the fire on its back.

attacks.name: Smokescreen
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokemon tries to attack during your opponent's next turn, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, that attack does nothing.

attacks.name: Char
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokemon doesn't have a Char counter on it, flip a coin. If heads, put a Char counter on it. A Char counter requires your opponent to flip a coin after every turn. If tails, put 2 damage counters on the Pokemon with that Char counter. (Char counters stay on the Pokemon as long as it's in play.)

cards.name: Seadra
cards.flavor: An examination of its cells revealed the presence of a gene not found in Horsea. It became a hot topic.

attacks.name: Bubble
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokemon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Mud Splash
attacks.text: If your opponent has any Benched Pokemon, choose 1 of them and flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage to that Pokemon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokemon.)

cards.name: Skiploom
cards.flavor: The bloom on top of its head opens and closes as the temperature fluctuates up and down.

attacks.name: Poisonpowder
attacks.text: The Defending Pokemon is now Poisoned.

attacks.name: Stun Spore
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokemon is now Paralyzed.

cards.name: Sunflora
cards.flavor: It converts sunlight into energy. In the darkness after sunset, it closes its petals and becomes still.

attacks.name: Petal Dance
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads. Sunflora is now Confused (after doing damage).

cards.name: Togepi
cards.flavor: A proverb claims that happiness will come to anyone who can make a sleeping Togepi stand up.

attacks.name: Poison Barb
attacks.text: The Defending Pokemon is now Poisoned.

cards.name: Xatu
cards.flavor: They say that it stays still and quiet because it is seeing both the past and future at the same time.

attacks.name: Prophecy
attacks.text: Look at the top 3 cards of either player's deck and rearrange them as you like.

attacks.name: Confuse Ray
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokemon is now Confused.

cards.name: Chikorita
