cards.flavor: A sweet aroma gently wafts from the leaf on its head. It is docile and loves to soak up the sun's rays.

attacks.name: Deflector
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, whenever Chikorita takes damage, divide that damage in half (rounded down to the nearest 10). (Any other effects still happen.)

cards.name: Chikorita
cards.flavor: Its pleasantly aromatic leaf has the ability to check the humidity and temperature.

attacks.name: Growl
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokemon attacks Chikorita during your opponent's next turn, any damage done to Chikorita is reduced by 10 (before applying Weakness and Resistance). (Benching or evolving either Pokemon ends this effect.)

cards.name: Chinchou
cards.flavor: It shoots positive and negative electricity between the tips of its two antennae and zaps its enemies.

attacks.name: Supersonic
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokemon is now Confused.

attacks.name: Flail
attacks.text: Does 10 damage times the number of damage counters on Chinchou.

cards.name: Cyndaquil
cards.flavor: It usually stays hunched over. If it is angry or surprised, it shoots flames out of its back.

attacks.name: Leer
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokemon can't attack Cyndaquil during your opponent's next turn. (Benching or evolving either Pokemon ends this effect.)

attacks.name: Swift
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness, Resistance, Pokemon Powers, or any other effects on the Defending Pokemon.

cards.name: Cyndaquil
cards.flavor: It is timid and always curls itself up in a ball. If attacked, it flares up its back for protection.

attacks.name: Fireworks
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, discard 1 Energy card attached to Cyndaquil.

attacks.name: Quick Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage plus 20 more damage; if tails, this attack does 10 damage.

cards.name: Girafarig
cards.flavor: Its tail has a small brain of its own. Beware! If you get close, it may react to your scent and bite.

attacks.name: Agility
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to Girafarig.

attacks.name: Psybeam
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokemon is now Confused.

cards.name: Gligar
cards.flavor: It flies straight at its target's face, then clamps down on the startled victim to inject poison.

attacks.name: Poison Sting
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokemon is now Poisoned.

cards.name: Hoothoot
cards.flavor: It always stands on one foot. It changes feet so fast that the movement can rarely be seen.

attacks.name: Hypnosis
attacks.text: The Defending Pokemon is now Asleep.

cards.name: Hoppip
cards.flavor: To keep from being blown away by the wind, they gather in clusters. They do enjoy gentle breezes, though.

attacks.name: Sprout
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Basic Pokemon named Hoppip and put it onto your Bench. Shuffle your deck afterward. (You can't use this attack if your Bench is full.)

cards.name: Horsea
cards.flavor: If attacked by a larger enemy, it quickly swims to safety by adeptly controlling its dorsal fin.

attacks.name: Fin Slap
attacks.text: If an attack damaged Horsea during your opponent's last turn, this attack does 20 damage plus 10 more damage. If not, this attack does 20 damage.

cards.name: Ledyba
cards.flavor: It is very timid. It's afraid to move if alone, but it's active if in a group.

attacks.name: Supersonic
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokemon is now Confused.

attacks.name: Comet Punch
attacks.text: Flip 4 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

cards.name: Mantine
cards.flavor: Swimming freely in open seas, it may fly out of the water and over the waves if it builds up enough speed.

attacks.name: Undulate
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to Mantine.

cards.name: Mareep
cards.flavor: If static electricity builds in its body, its fleece doubles in volume. Touching it will shock you.

attacks.name: Static Electricity
attacks.text: For each Mareep in play, you may search your deck for a Lightning Energy card and attach it to Mareep. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Thundershock
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokemon is now Paralyzed.

cards.name: Marill
cards.flavor: The end of its tail serves as a buoy that keeps it from drowning, even in a vicious current.

attacks.name: Defense Curl
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all damage done to Marill during your opponent's next turn. (Any other effects of attacks still happen.)

attacks.name: Bubble Bomb
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokemon is now Paralyzed. If tails, Marill does 10 damage to itself.

cards.name: Natu
cards.flavor: Because its wings aren't yet fully grown, it has to hop to get around. It is always staring at something.

attacks.name: Telekinesis
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokemon. This attack does 20 damage to that Pokemon. Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for this attack. (Any other effects that would happen after applying Weakness and Resistance still happen.)

cards.name: Oddish
cards.flavor: Awakened by moonlight, it roams actively at night. In the day it stays quietly underground.

attacks.name: Hide
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to Oddish.

attacks.name: Absorb
attacks.text: Remove a number of damage counters from Oddish equal to half the damage done to the Defending Pokemon (after applying Weakness and Resistance) (rounded up to the nearest 10). If Oddish has fewer damage counters than that, remove all of them.

cards.name: Onix
cards.flavor: It twists and squirms through the ground. The thunderous roar of its tunneling echoes a long way.

attacks.name: Screech
attacks.text: Until the end of your next turn, if an attack damages the Defending Pokemon (after applying Weakness and Resistance), that attack does 20 more damage to the Defending Pokemon.

attacks.name: Rage
attacks.text: Does 10 damage plus 10 more damage for each damage counter on Onix.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.flavor: It raises its tail to check its surroundings. The tail is sometimes struck by lightning in this pose.

attacks.name: Quick Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage plus 20 more damage; if tails, this attack does 10 damage.

attacks.name: Agility
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to Pikachu.

cards.name: Sentret
cards.flavor: A very cautious Pokemon, it raises itself up using its tail to get a better view of its surroundings.

attacks.name: Fury Swipes
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

cards.name: Shuckle
cards.flavor: The Berries it stores in its vaselike shell decompose and become a gooey liquid.

attacks.name: Withdraw
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all damage done to Shuckle during your opponent's next turn. (Any other effects of attacks still happen.)

attacks.name: Wrap
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokemon is now Paralyzed.

cards.name: Slowpoke
cards.flavor: It lazes vacantly near water. If something bites its tail, it won't even notice for a whole day.

attacks.name: Psyshock
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokemon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Water Gun
attacks.text: Does 10 damage plus 10 more damage for each Water Energy attached to Slowpoke but not used to pay for this attack's Energy cost. You can't add more than 20 damage in this way.

cards.name: Snubbull
cards.flavor: Although it looks frightening, it is actually kind and affectionate. It is very popular.

attacks.name: Roar
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads and if your opponent has any Benched Pokemon, he of she chooses 1 of them and switches it with the Defending Pokemon. (Do the damage before switching the Pokemon.)

attacks.name: Lick
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokemon is now Paralyzed.

cards.name: Spinarak
cards.flavor: It lies still in the same pose for days in its web, waiting for its unsuspecting prey to wander close.

attacks.name: Scary Face
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, until the end of your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokemon can't attack or retreat.

attacks.name: String Shot
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokemon is now Paralyzed.

cards.name: Stantler
cards.flavor: The curved antlers subtly change the flow of air to create a strange space where reality is distorted.

attacks.name: Stomp
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 damage plus 10 more damage; if tails, this attack does 20 damage.

attacks.name: Mystifying Horns
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokemon is now Confused.

cards.name: Sudowoodo
cards.flavor: Although it always pretends to be a tree, its composition appears to be closer to a rock than a plant.

attacks.name: Flail
attacks.text: Does 10 damage times the number of damage counters on Sudowoodo.

cards.name: Sunkern
cards.flavor: It may drop out of the sky suddenly. If attacked by a Spearow, it violently shakes its leaves.

attacks.name: Growth
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, you may attach up to 2 Grass Energy cards from your hand to Sunkern.

attacks.name: Mega Drain
attacks.text: Remove a number of damage counters from Sunkern equal to half the damage done to the Defending Pokemon (after applying Weakness and Resistance) (rounded up to the nearest 10). If Sunkern has fewer damage counters than that, remove all of them.

cards.name: Swinub
cards.flavor: It rubs its snout on the ground to find and dig up food. It sometimes discovers hot springs.

attacks.name: Powder Snow
attacks.text: The Defending Pokemon is now Asleep.

cards.name: Totodile
cards.flavor: It is small but rough and tough. It won't hesitate to take a bite out of anything that moves.

attacks.name: Rage
attacks.text: Does 10 damage plus 10 more damage for each damage counter on Totodile.

cards.name: Totodile
cards.flavor: Its well-developed jaws are powerful and capable of crushing anything. Even its trainer must be careful.

attacks.name: Leer
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokemon can't attack Totodile during your opponent's next turn. (Benching or evolving either Pokemon ends this effect.)

attacks.name: Fury Swipes
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

cards.name: Wooper
cards.flavor: This Pokemon lives in cold water. It leaves the water to search for food when it gets cold outside.

attacks.name: Amnesia
attacks.text: Choose 1 of the Defending Pokemon's attacks. That Pokemon can't use that attack during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Slam
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.

cards.name: Arcade Game
cards.text: Shuffle your deck, then reveal the top 3 cards of it. If at least 2 of those cards share the same name, put all the ones with that name into your hand and shuffle the rest into your deck. If none of them do, shuffle all 3 into your deck.

cards.name: Ecogym
cards.text: This card stays in play when you play it. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play. Whenever an attack, Pokemon Power, or Trainer card discards another player's non-Colorless Energy card from a Pokemon, return that Energy card to its owner's hand. (Energy cards that are discarded when that Pokemon is Knocked Out don't count.)

cards.name: Energy Charge
cards.text: Flip a coin. If heads, shuffle up to 2 Energy cards from your discard pile into your deck.

cards.name: Focus Band
cards.text: Attach Focus Band to 1 of your Pokemon that doesn't have a Pokemon Tool attached to it. If the Pokemon Focus Band is attached to would be Knocked Out by your opponent's attack, flip a coin. If heads, that Pokemon is not Knocked Out and its remaining HP become 10 instead. Then, discard Focus Band.

cards.name: Mary
cards.text: Draw 2 cards. Then, shuffle 2 cards from your hand into your deck.

cards.name: PokeGear
cards.text: Look at the top 7 cards of your deck. If any of them are Trainer cards, you may show 1 of them to your opponent and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward. You can't play any more Trainer cards this turn.

cards.name: Super Energy Retrieval
cards.text: Trade 2 of the other cards in your hand for 4 basic Energy cards from your discard pile. If you have fewer than 4 basic Energy cards there, take all of them.

cards.name: Time Capsule
cards.text: Your opponent may choose 5 Basic Pokemon, Evolution, and/or basic Energy cards in his or her discard pile. (If your opponent doesn't have that many, he or she chooses all or none of them.) If your opponent chooses any cards, he or she shuffles them into his or her deck. Either way, you may do the same, and you can't play any more Trainer cards this turn.

cards.name: Bill's Teleporter
cards.text: Flip a coin. If heads, draw 4 cards.

cards.name: Card-Flip Game
cards.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's face-down Prizes. Guess whether it is an Energy card, a Trainer card, or a Pokemon (Basic or Evolution) card. Flip the card face up (and leave it face up). If you guessed right, draw 2 cards.

cards.name: Gold Berry
cards.text: Attach Gold Berry to 1 of your Pokemon that doesn't have a Pokemon Tool attached to it. At any time between turns, if there are at least 4 damage counters on the Pokemon Gold Berry is attached to, you may remove 4 of them and discard Gold Berry. At the start of each turn, if there are at least 4 damage counters on the Pokemon Gold Berry is attached to, remove 4 of them and discard Gold Berry.

cards.name: Miracle Berry
cards.text: Attach Miracle Berry to 1 of your Pokemon that doesn't have a Pokemon Tool attached to it. At any time between turns, if the Pokemon Miracle Berry is attached to is Asleep, Confused, Paralyzed, or Poisoned, you may remove all those effects from that Pokemon and discard Miracle Berry. At the start of each turn, if the Pokemon Miracle Berry is attached to is Asleep, Confused, Paralyzed, or Poisoned, remove all of those effects from that Pokemon and discard Miracle Berry.

cards.name: New Pokedex
cards.text: Shuffle your deck. Then, look at up to 5 cards from the top of your deck and rearrange them as you like.

cards.name: Professor Elm
cards.text: Shuffle your hand into your deck. Then, draw 7 cards. You can't play any more Trainer cards this turn.

cards.name: Sprout Tower
cards.text: This card stays in play when you play it. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play. All damage done by Colorless Pokemon's attacks is reduced by 30 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.name: Super Scoop Up
cards.text: Flip a coin. If heads, return 1 of your Pokemon and all cards attached to it to your hand.

cards.name: Berry
cards.text: Attach Berry to 1 of your Pokemon that doesn't have a Pokemon Tool attached to it. At any time between turns, if there are at least 2 damage counters on the Pokemon Berry is attached to, you may remove 2 of them and discard Berry. At the start of each turn, if there are at least 2 damage counters on the Pokemon Berry is attached to, remove 2 of them and discard Berry.

cards.name: Double Gust
cards.text: If you have any Benched Pokemon, your opponent chooses 1 of them and switches it with your Active Pokemon. Then, if your opponent has any Benched Pokemon, choose 1 of them and switch it with his or her Active Pokemon.

cards.name: Moo-Moo Milk
cards.text: Choose 1 of your Pokemon. Flip 2 coins. Remove 2 damage counters times the number of heads from that Pokemon. If the Pokemon has fewer damage counters than that, remove all of them.

cards.name: Pokemon March
cards.text: Your opponent may search his or her deck for 1 Basic Pokemon card and put it onto his or her Bench. Then, you may search your deck for 1 Basic Pokemon card and put it onto your Bench. Then, each player shuffles his or her deck. (A player can't do any of this if his or her Bench is full.)

cards.name: Super Rod
cards.text: Flip a coin. If heads, put an Evolution card from your discard pile, if any, into your hand. If tails, put a Basic Pokemon card from your discard pile, if any, into your hand.

cards.name: Darkness Energy
cards.text: If the Pokemon Darkness Energy is attached to damages the Defending Pokemon (after applying Weakness and Resistance), the attack does 10 more damage to the Defending Pokemon. At the end of every turn, put 1 damage counter on the Pokemon Darkness Energy is attached to, unless it's Darkness or has Dark in its name. Darkness Energy provides Darkness Energy. (Doesn't count as a basic Energy card.)

cards.name: Recycle Energy
cards.text: Recycle Energy provides Colorless Energy. (Doesn't count as a basic Energy card.) If this card is put into your discard pile from play, return it to your hand.

cards.name: Espeon
cards.flavor: It uses the fine hair that covers its body to sense air currents and predict its enemy's actions.

attacks.name: Psychic
attacks.text: Does 30 damage plus 10 more damage for each Energy card attached to the Defending Pokemon.

cards.name: Forretress
cards.flavor: Its entire body is shielded by a steel-hard shell. What lurks inside the armor is a total mystery.

attacks.name: Rapid Spin
attacks.text: If your opponent has any Benched Pokemon, he or she chooses 1 of them and switches it with his or her Active Pokemon, then, if you have any Benched Pokemon, you switch 1 of them with your Active Pokemon. (Do the damage before switching the Pokemon.)

ability.name: Spikes
ability.text: During your opponent's turn, whenever 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokemon becomes his or her Active Pokemon, Forretress does 10 damage to it. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance.) This power stops working if Forretress is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

cards.name: Hitmontop
cards.flavor: If you become enchanted by its smooth, elegant, dancelike kicks, you may get drilled hard.

attacks.name: Detect
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to Hitmontop.

attacks.name: Triple Kick
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads.

cards.name: Houndoom
cards.flavor: Upon hearing its eerie howls, other Pokemon get the shivers and head straight back to their nests.

attacks.name: Crunch
attacks.text: Until the end of your next turn, if an attack damages the Defending Pokemon (after applying Weakness and Resistance), that attack does 20 more damage to the Defending Pokemon.

attacks.name: Flamethrower
attacks.text: Discard 1 Fire Energy card attached to Houndoom or this attack does nothing.

cards.name: Houndour
cards.flavor: To corner prey, they check each other's location using barks that only they can understand.

attacks.name: Smog
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokemon is now Poisoned.

attacks.name: Collect Fire
attacks.text: If there are any Fire Energy cards in your discard pile, choose 1 of them and attach it to Houndour.

cards.name: Kabutops
cards.flavor: In the water, it tucks its limbs to become more compact, then it wiggles its shell to swim fast.

attacks.name: Hydrocutter
attacks.text: Flip a number of coins equal to the number of Energy cards attached to Kabutops. This attack does 40 damage times the number of heads. You can't flip more than 3 coins in this way.

cards.name: Magnemite
cards.flavor: These Pokemon are attracted to electrical emissions and will often follow people using PokeGear.

attacks.name: Lock-on
attacks.text: During your next turn, treat any tails flipped when using Magnemite's Electric Bolt attack as if they were heads. (Benching or evolving either Pokemon ends this effect.)

attacks.name: Electric Bolt
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. If both are heads, the Defending Pokemon is now Paralyzed. If either of them is tails, this attack does nothing (not even damage).

cards.name: Politoed
cards.flavor: Whenever three or more of these get together, they sing in a loud voice that sounds like bellowing.

attacks.name: Doubleslap
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 40 damage times the number of heads.

ability.name: Frog Song
ability.text: Whenever Politoed's attack damages the Defending Pokemon (after applying Weakness and Resistance), if there are more than 3 Poliwags, Poliwhirls, Poliwraths, and/or Politoeds in play (including your opponent's), that attack does 40 more damage (no matter how many heads you get). This power stops working while Politoed is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

cards.name: Poliwrath
cards.flavor: Although an energetic, skilled swimmer that uses all of its muscles, it lives on dry land.

attacks.name: Submission
attacks.text: Poliwrath does 20 damage to itself.

cards.name: Scizor
cards.flavor: It swings its eye patterned pincers up to scare its foes. This makes it look like it has three heads.

attacks.name: False Swipe
attacks.text: Does damage equal to half the Defending Pokemon's remaining HP (rounded down to the nearest 10).

attacks.name: Double Claw
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.

cards.name: Smeargle
cards.flavor: A special fluid oozes from the tip of its tail. It paints the fluid everywhere to mark its territory.

attacks.name: Sketch
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokemon attacked last turn, and Smeargle was in play during that attack, Smeargle copies that attack except for its Energy costs and anything else required in order to use that attack.

cards.name: Tyranitar
cards.flavor: Its body can't be harmed by any sort of attack, so it is very eager to make challenges against enemies.

attacks.name: Slam
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Trample
attacks.text: For each Benched Pokemon in play (yours and your opponent's), flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 damage to that Pokemon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokemon.)

cards.name: Umbreon
cards.flavor: When darkness falls, the rings on the body begin to glow, striking fear in the hearts of anyone nearby.

cards.name: Unown [A]
cards.flavor: Their shapes look like hieroglyphs on ancient tablets. It is said that the two are somehow related.

ability.name: [Anger]
ability.text: Whenever 1 of your Pokemon with Unown in its name uses its Hidden Power attack, that attack does 10 more damage for each damage counter on Unown [A]. If you have more than 1 Unown [A] in play, use only 1 [Anger] for each attack.

cards.name: Ursaring
cards.flavor: Although it is a good climber, it prefers to snap trees with its forelegs and eat fallen berries.

attacks.name: Headpress
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokemon is now Paralyzed. If tails, this attack does nothing (not even damage).

attacks.name: Double Lariat
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 40 damage times the number of heads.

cards.name: Wobbuffet
cards.flavor: To keep its pitch-black tail hidden, it lives quietly in the darkness. It is never first to attack.

attacks.name: Counter
attacks.text: If an attack damages Wobbuffet during your opponent's next turn (even if Wobbuffet is Knocked Out), flip a coin. If heads, Wobbuffet attacks the Defending Pokemon for an equal amount of damage.

cards.name: Yanma
cards.flavor: If it flaps its wings really fast, it can generate shock waves that will shatter windows in the area.

attacks.name: Shockwave
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Pokemon. Don't apply Weakness and Resistance. Then, if your opponent has any Benched Pokemon, he or she chooses 1 of them and switches it with the Defending Pokemon.

attacks.name: Swift
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness, Resistance, Pokemon Powers, or any other effects on the Defending Pokemon.

cards.name: Beedrill
cards.flavor: It can take down any opponent with its powerful poison stingers. It sometimes attacks in swarms.

attacks.name: Triple Poison
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokemon is now Poisoned. Your opponent now puts 3 damage counters on it instead of 1 after each player's turn (even if it was already Poisoned).

attacks.name: Pin Missile
attacks.text: Flip 4 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.

cards.name: Butterfree
cards.flavor: It collects honey every day. It rubs honey onto the hairs on its legs to carry it back to its nest.

attacks.name: Magic Dust
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokemon is now either Asleep, Confused, Paralyzed, or Poisoned (your choice).

attacks.name: Hyper Reverse
attacks.text: Does 10 damage times the number of Energy attached to the Defending Pokemon. After doing damage, remove a number of damage counters from Butterfree equal to the amount of damage done to the Defending Pokemon (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.name: Espeon
cards.flavor: By reading air currents, it can predict things such as the weather or its foe's next move.

attacks.name: Quick Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage plus 20 more damage; if tails, this attack does 10 damage.

attacks.name: Psybeam
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokemon is now Confused.

ability.text: During your opponent's turn, whenever 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokemon becomes his or her Active Pokemon, Forretress does 10 damage to it. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance.) This power stops working if Forretress is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Double Claw
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.

cards.name: Smeargle
cards.flavor: A special fluid oozes from the tip of its tail. It paints the fluid everywhere to mark its territory.

attacks.name: Sketch
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokemon attacked last turn, and Smeargle was in play during that attack, Smeargle copies that attack except for its Energy costs and anything else required in order to use that attack.

cards.name: Tyranitar
cards.flavor: Its body can't be harmed by any sort of attack, so it is very eager to make challenges against enemies.

attacks.name: Slam
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Trample
attacks.text: For each Benched Pokemon in play (yours and your opponent's), flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 damage to that Pokemon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokemon.)

cards.name: Umbreon
cards.flavor: When agitated, this Pokemon protects itself by spraying poisonous sweat from its pores.

attacks.name: Quick Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage plus 20 more damage; if tails, this attack does 10 damage.

attacks.name: Pursuit
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, if the Defending Pokemon tries to retreat, do 10 damage to it. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance.)

cards.name: Unown [A]
cards.flavor: Their shapes look like hieroglyphs on ancient tablets. It is said that the two are somehow related.

ability.name: [Anger]
ability.text: Whenever 1 of your Pokemon with Unown in its name uses its Hidden Power attack, that attack does 10 more damage for each damage counter on Unown [A]. If you have more than 1 Unown [A] in play, use only 1 [Anger] for each attack.

cards.name: Ursaring
cards.flavor: Although it is a good climber, it prefers to snap trees with its forelegs and eat fallen berries.

attacks.name: Headpress
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokemon is now Paralyzed. If tails, this attack does nothing (not even damage).

attacks.name: Double Lariat
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 40 damage times the number of heads.

cards.name: Wobbuffet
cards.flavor: To keep its pitch-black tail hidden, it lives quietly in the darkness. It is never first to attack.

attacks.name: Counter
attacks.text: If an attack damages Wobbuffet during your opponent's next turn (even if Wobbuffet is Knocked Out), flip a coin. If heads, Wobbuffet attacks the Defending Pokemon for an equal amount of damage.

cards.name: Yanma
cards.flavor: If it flaps its wings really fast, it can generate shock waves that will shatter windows in the area.

attacks.name: Shockwave
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Pokemon. Don't apply Weakness and Resistance. Then, if your opponent has any Benched Pokemon, he or she chooses 1 of them and switches it with the Defending Pokemon.

attacks.name: Swift
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness, Resistance, Pokemon Powers, or any other effects on the Defending Pokemon.

cards.name: Corsola
cards.flavor: It continuously sheds and grows. The tip of its head is prized as a treasure because of its beauty.

attacks.name: Recover
attacks.text: Discard 1 Water Energy card attached to Corsola or this attack does nothing. Remove all damage counters from Corsola.

attacks.name: Spike Cannon
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads.

cards.name: Eevee
cards.flavor: Its irregularly configured DNA is affected by its surroundings. It evolves if its environment changes.

ability.name: Energy Evolution
ability.text: Whenever you attach an Energy card to Eevee, flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for a card that evolves from Eevee that is the same type as the Energy card you attached to Eevee. Attach that card to Eevee. This counts as evolving Eevee. Shuffle your deck afterward. This power can't be used if Eevee is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

cards.name: Houndour
cards.flavor: It uses different kinds of cries for communicating with others of its kind and for pursuing its prey.

attacks.name: Plunder
attacks.text: Before doing damage, discard all Trainer cards attached to the Defending Pokemon (before they affect the damage).

cards.name: Igglybuff
cards.flavor: It has a very soft body. If it starts to roll, it will bounce all over and be impossible to stop.

ability.name: Gaze
ability.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), choose 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokemon that has a Pokemon Power. That power stops working until the end of this turn. This effect ends if that Pokemon leaves the Bench.

cards.name: Kakuna
cards.flavor: Although it is a cocoon, it can move a little. It can extend its poison barb if it is attacked.

attacks.name: Secrete Poison
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, whenever your opponent's attack damages Kakuna (even if Kakuna is Knocked Out), your opponent's Active Pokemon is now Poisoned and Kakuna does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokemon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokemon.)

cards.name: Metapod
cards.flavor: Inside the shell, it is soft and weak as it prepares to evolve. It stays motionless in the shell.

attacks.name: Harden
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, whenever 20 or less damage is done to Metapod (after applying Weakness and Resistance), prevent that damage. (Any other effects of attacks still happen).

attacks.name: Hatch
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, remove all damage counters from Metapod. Then, search your deck for a card that evolves from Metapod and attach that card to Metapod. This counts as evolving Metapod. Shuffle your deck afterward.

cards.name: Omastar
cards.flavor: Apparently, it cracked Shellder's shell with its sharp fangs and sucked out the insides.

attacks.name: Squeeze
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage plus 20 more damage and the Defending Pokemon is now Paralyzed. If tails, this attack does 10 damage.

attacks.name: Spike Barrage
attacks.text: Flip a number of coins equal to the number of Water Energy attached to Omastar. This attack does 20 damage plus 20 more damage for each heads.

cards.name: Poliwhirl
cards.flavor: The swirl on its belly undulates. Staring at it may gradually cause drowsiness.

attacks.name: Belly Drum
attacks.text: Put 3 damage counters on Poliwhirl. If this doesn't Knock Out Poliwhirl, search your deck for 2 Basic Energy cards and attach them to Poliwhirl. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Water Gun
attacks.text: Does 30 damage plus 10 more damage for each Water Energy attached to Poliwhirl but not used to pay for this attack's Energy cost. You can't add more than 20 damage in this way.

cards.name: Pupitar
cards.flavor: Its shell is as hard as sheet rock, and it is also very strong. Its thrashing can topple a mountain.

attacks.name: Dust Devil
attacks.text: Does 10 damage to each non-Fighting Pokemon in play. Don't apply Weakness and Resistance.

cards.name: Scyther
cards.flavor: It slashes through grass with its sharp scythes, moving too fast for the human eye to track.

attacks.name: Fury Cutter
attacks.text: Flip 4 coins. This attack does 10 damage plus 10 more damage if exactly 1 is heads, or 20 more damage if exactly 2 are heads, or 40 more damage if exactly 3 are heads, or 80 more damage if all 4 are heads.

cards.name: Unown [D]
cards.flavor: Their shapes look like hieroglyphs on ancient tablets. It is said that the two are somehow related.

ability.name: [Darkness]
ability.text: Whenever a Darkness Pokemon damages 1 of your Pokemon, reduce that damage by 30 (after applying Weakness and Resistance). This power stops working if you have more than 1 Unown [D] in play. (This power works even if Unown [D] is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.)

cards.name: Unown [F]
cards.flavor: Their shapes look like hieroglyphs on ancient tablets. It is said that the two are somehow related.

ability.name: [Find]
ability.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), if you have Unown [F], Unown [I], Unown [N], and Unown [D] on your Bench, you may search your deck for a Trainer card. Show that card to your opponent, then put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

cards.name: Unown [M]
cards.flavor: Their shapes look like hieroglyphs on ancient tablets. It is said that the two are somehow related.

ability.name: [Metal]
ability.text: Whenever a Metal Pokemon damages 1 of your Pokemon, reduce that damage by 30 (after applying Weakness and Resistance). This power stops working if you have more than 1 Unown [M] in play. (This power works even if Unown [M] is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.)

cards.name: Unown [N]
cards.flavor: Their shapes look like hieroglyphs on ancient tablets. It is said that the two are somehow related.

ability.name: [Normal]
ability.text: Whenever a Colorless Pokemon damages 1 of your Pokemon, reduce that damage by 30 (after applying Weakness and Resistance). This power stops working if you have more than 1 Unown [N] in play. (This power works even if Unown [N] is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.)

cards.name: Unown [U]
cards.flavor: Their shapes look like hieroglyphs on ancient tablets. It is said that the two are somehow related.

ability.name: [Undo]
ability.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), if you have Unown [U], Unown [N], Unown [D], and Unown [O] on your Bench, you may return your Active Pokemon and all cards attached to it to your hand.

cards.name: Xatu
cards.flavor: In South America, it is said that its right eye sees the future and its left eye views the past.

attacks.name: Energy Cycle
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, choose 1 Energy card attached to the Defending Pokemon and 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokemon. Attach that Energy card to that Pokemon.

cards.name: Caterpie
cards.flavor: For protection, it releases a horrible stench from the antennae on its head to drive away enemies.

attacks.name: Spin Tackle
attacks.text: Caterpie does 10 damage to itself.

cards.name: Dunsparce
cards.flavor: When spotted, this Pokemon escapes backward by furiously boring into the ground with its tail.

attacks.name: Glare
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokemon is now Paralyzed.

cards.name: Hoppip
cards.flavor: Its body is so light, it must grip the ground firmly with its feet to keep from being blown away.

cards.name: Kabuto
cards.flavor: On rare occasions, some have been found as fossils which they became while hiding on the ocean floor.

attacks.name: Work Together
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage plus 10 more damage for each Omanyte, Omastar, Kabuto, and Kabutops on your Bench.

ability.name: Revive Friends
ability.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for a card named Kabuto and put it on your Bench. Shuffle your deck afterward. Treat the new Kabuto as a Basic Pokemon. This power can't be used if Kabuto is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed (or if your Bench is full).

cards.name: Larvitar
cards.flavor: It feeds on soil. After it has eaten a large mountain, it will fall asleep so it can grow.

cards.name: Mareep
cards.flavor: Its fleece grows continually. In the summer, the fleece is fully shed, but it grows back in a week.

attacks.name: Thunder Jolt
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, Mareep does 10 damage to itself.

cards.name: Natu
cards.flavor: It usually forages for food on the ground but may, on rare occasions, hop onto branches to peck at shoots.

attacks.name: Confuse Ray
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokemon is now Confused

cards.name: Omanyte
cards.flavor: Revived from an ancient fossil, this Pokemon uses air stored in its shell to sink and rise in water.

attacks.name: Bind
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokemon is now Paralyzed.

ability.name: Revive Fossil
ability.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for a card that evolves from Mysterious Fossil and put it onto your Bench. Shuffle your deck afterward. Treat that card as a Basic Pokemon. This power can't be used if Omanyte is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed (or if your Bench is full).

cards.name: Pineco
cards.flavor: It likes to make its shell thicker by adding layers of tree bark. The additional weight doesn't bother it.

attacks.name: Burst
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, Pineco does 40 damage to itself and 10 damage to each Pokemon on each player's Bench. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokemon.) Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing (not even damage).

cards.name: Poliwag
cards.flavor: Because it is inept at walking on its newly grown legs, it always swims around in water.

attacks.name: Hypnosis
attacks.text: The Defending Pokemon is now Asleep.

cards.name: Sentret
cards.flavor: It stands on its tail so it can see a long way. If it spots an enemy, it cries loudly to warn its kind.

attacks.name: Scout
attacks.text: Look at your opponent's hand.

cards.name: Spinarak
cards.flavor: It spins a web using fine – but durable – thread. It then waits patiently for prey to be trapped.

attacks.name: Poison Sting
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokemon is now Poisoned.

cards.name: Teddiursa
cards.flavor: If it finds honey, its crescent mark glows. It always licks its paws because they are soaked with honey.

attacks.name: Nap Time
attacks.text: Remove all damage counters from Teddiursa. Teddiursa is now Asleep.

cards.name: Tyrogue
cards.flavor: It is always bursting with energy. To make itself stronger, it keeps on fighting even if it loses.

attacks.name: Smash Punch
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

cards.name: Unown [E]
cards.flavor: Their shapes look like hieroglyphs on ancient tablets. It is said that the two are somehow related.

ability.name: [Engage]
ability.text: When you play Unown [E] from your hand, your opponent may shuffle his or her hand into his or her deck and then draw 4 cards. Either way, you may shuffle your hand into your deck and draw 4 cards.

cards.name: Unown [I]
cards.flavor: Their shapes look like hieroglyphs on ancient tablets. It is said that the two are somehow related.

ability.name: [Increase]
ability.text: When you play Unown [I] from your hand, you may search your deck for a card with Unown in its name and put it onto your Bench. Shuffle your deck afterward. You can't use this power if your Bench is full.

cards.name: Unown [O]
cards.flavor: Their shapes look like hieroglyphs on ancient tablets. It is said that the two are somehow related.

ability.name: [Observe]
ability.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may look at 5 cards from the top of your opponent's deck and put them back in the same order.

cards.name: Weedle
cards.flavor: Its poison stinger is very powerful. Its bright-colored body is intended to warn off its enemies.

attacks.name: Spike Stab
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokemon is now Poisoned. If tails, this attack does nothing (not even damage).

cards.name: Wooper
cards.flavor: When it walks around on the ground, it coats its body with a slimy, poisonous film.

attacks.name: Slime
attacks.text: If an attack would do damage to Wooper during your opponent's next turn, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, prevent all damage to Wooper from that attack. (Any other effects of that attack happen.)

cards.name: Fossil Egg
cards.text: Flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for a card that evolves from Mysterious Fossil and put it onto your Bench or put a card that evolves from Mysterious Fossil from your hand onto your Bench. Either way, treat the new card as a Basic Pokemon. If you searched your deck, shuffle it. (You can't play this card if your Bench is full.)

cards.name: Hyper Devolution Spray
cards.text: Choose 1 of your evolved Pokemon. Take the highest Stage Evolution card from that Pokemon and put it into your hand. (You can't evolve a Pokemon the turn you devolve it.)

cards.name: Ruin Wall
cards.text: Search your deck for a card with Unown in its name and put it onto your Bench. Shuffle your deck afterward. (You can't play this card if your Bench is full.)

cards.name: Energy Ark
cards.text: Flip 2 coins. For each heads, search your deck for a Basic Energy card. Show that card to your opponent, then put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

cards.name: Ampharos
cards.flavor: The bright light on its tail can be seen far away. It has been treasured since ancient times as a beacon.

attacks.name: Attract Current
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. For each heads, you may search your deck for a Lightning Energy card and attach it to 1 of your Lightning Pokemon. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Gigavolt
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 40 damage plus 20 more damage. If tails, this attack does 40 damage and the Defending Pokemon is now Paralyzed.

cards.name: Blissey
cards.flavor: Anyone who takes even one bite of Blissey's egg becomes unfailingly caring and pleasant to everyone.

attacks.name: Body Slam
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokemon is now Paralyzed.

ability.name: Softboiled
ability.text: When you play Blissey from your hand, you may flip a coin. If heads, remove 8 damage counters from Blissey. If tails, remove 4 damage counters from Blissey. Either way, if Blissey has fewer damage counters than that, remove all of them.

cards.name: Celebi
cards.flavor: This Pokemon wanders across time. Grass and trees flourish in the forests in which it has appeared.

attacks.name: Psychic Damage
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. For each heads, put 1 damage counter on the Defending Pokemon.

ability.name: Time Travel
ability.text: If an opponent's attack would Knock Out Celebi, flip a coin. If heads, Celebi isn't Knocked Out and you shuffle it and all cards attached to it into your deck. This power doesn't work if Celebi is already Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

cards.name: Crobat
cards.flavor: It flies so silently through the dark on its four wings that it may not be noticed even when nearby.

attacks.name: Triggered Poison
attacks.text: If your opponent attaches an Energy card to the Defending Pokemon during his or her next turn, that Pokemon becomes Poisoned.

attacks.name: Cross Attack
attacks.text: Flip 4 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads. If you get 2 or more heads, the Defending Pokemon is now Confused.

cards.name: Delibird
cards.flavor: It carries food all day long. There are tales about lost people who were saved by the food it had.

attacks.name: Present
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. If exactly 1 is heads, this attack does 40 damage. If exactly 2 are heads, remove 3 damage counters from the Defending Pokemon. If the Defending Pokemon has fewer damage counters than that, remove all of them. If all 3 are heads, this attack does 60 damage. If all 3 are tails, remove all damage counters from the Defending Pokemon.

cards.name: Entei
cards.flavor: Volcanoes erupt when it barks. Unable to restrain its extreme power, it races headlong around the land.

attacks.name: Searing Flames
attacks.text: Discard 2 Fire Energy cards attached to Entei or this attack does nothing.

ability.name: Howl
ability.text: When you play Entei from your hand, you may discard the top 5 cards of your deck. (If you have fewer cards in your deck than that, discard all of them.) If any of those are Fire Energy cards, attach them to any of your Fire Pokemon of your choice. Using this power ends your turn.

cards.name: Ho-oh
cards.flavor: Legends claim this Pokemon flies the world's skies continuously on its magnificent seven colored wings.

attacks.name: Stoke
attacks.text: You may search your deck for a Fire Energy card and attach it to Ho-Oh. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Sacred Fire
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, choose 1 of your opponent's Pokemon. This attack does 40 damage to that Pokemon. Don't apply Weakness and Resistance.

attacks.name: Dive Bomb
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

cards.name: Houndoom
cards.flavor: Upon hearing its eerie howls, other Pokemon get the shivers and head straight back to their nests.

attacks.name: Dark Flame
attacks.text: Discard 1 Fire Energy card attached to Houndoom or this attack does nothing. If there are any Darkness Energy cards in your discard pile, attach 1 of them to Houndoom.

attacks.name: Black Fang
attacks.text: Flip a number of coins equal to the number of Darkness Energy attached to Houndoom. This attack does 30 damage plus 10 more damage for each heads.

cards.name: Jumpluff
cards.flavor: Drifts on seasonal winds and spreads its cotton-like spores all over the world to make more offspring.

attacks.name: Evolutionary Spore
attacks.text: Choose any number of your Hoppips and Skiplooms. Then, for each Pokemon you chose in this way, you may search your deck for a card that evolves from that Pokemon and attach it to that Pokemon. (This counts as evolving those Pokemon.) Shuffle your deck afterward.

cards.name: Magneton
cards.flavor: Three Magnemites are linked by a strong magnetic force. Earaches will occur if you get too close.

attacks.name: Plasma
attacks.text: If there are any Lightning Energy cards in your discard pile, attach 1 of them to Magneton.

ability.name: Electromagnetic Power
ability.text: As often as you like during your turn (before your attack), you may take 1 Energy card attached to 1 of your Magnemites, Magnetons, or Dark Magnetons and attach it to a different 1 of your Magnemites, Magnetons, and Dark Magnetons. This power can't be used if Magneton is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

cards.name: Misdreavus
cards.flavor: It likes playing mischievous tricks such as screaming and wailing to startle people at night.

attacks.name: Night Eyes
attacks.text: The Defending Pokemon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Perish Song
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokemon is Asleep and was attacked with Night Eyes during your last turn, it is Knocked Out.

cards.name: Porygon2
cards.flavor: This upgraded version of Porygon is designed for space exploration. It can't fly, though.

attacks.name: Delta Beam
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, choose whether the Defending Pokemon becomes Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

ability.name: Energy Converter
ability.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may choose 1 basic Energy card attached to 1 of your Pokemon and choose an Energy type. Treat that Energy card as that type until the end of your turn. This power can't be used if Porygon2 is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed. If Porygon2 becomes Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed, the Energy card goes back to its original type.

cards.name: Raikou
cards.flavor: The rain clouds it carries let it fire thunderbolts at will. They say that it descended with lightning.

attacks.name: Lightning Tackle
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, Raikou does 20 damage to itself.

ability.name: Lightning Burst
ability.text: Whenever you attach a Lightning Energy card from your hand to Raikou, if your opponent has any Benched Pokemon, he or she chooses 1 of them and switches it with the Defending Pokemon. This power stops working while Raikou is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

cards.name: Suicune
cards.flavor: Said to be the reincarnation of north winds, it can instantly purify filthy, murky water.

attacks.name: Aurora Wave
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. If both are heads, the Defending Pokemon is now Paralyzed. If only 1 is heads, the Defending Pokemon is now Asleep.

ability.name: Crystal Body
ability.text: Prevent all effects of your opponent's attacks, other than damage, done to Suicune. This power stops working while Suicune is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

cards.name: Aerodactyl
cards.flavor: A vicious Pokemon from the distant past, it appears to have flown by spreading its wings and gliding.

attacks.name: Fly
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to Aerodactyl. If tails, this attack does nothing (not even damage).

ability.name: Prehistoric Memory
ability.text: Whenever an Evolved Pokemon attacks (even if it's your opponent's), it can use any attack from its Basic Pokemon card or any Evolution card attached to it. It still has to pay for that attack's Energy cost. This power stops working while Aerodactyl is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

cards.name: Celebi
cards.flavor: When Celebi disappears deep in a forest, it is said to leave behind an egg it brought from the future.

attacks.name: Psychic Leaf
attacks.text: Flip a coin for each Energy attached to the Defending Pokemon. This attack does 10 damage plus 10 more damage for each heads. Remove a number of damage counters from Celebi equal to the damage done to the Defending Pokemon (after applying Weakness and Resistance). If Celebi has fewer damage counters than that, remove all of them.

cards.name: Entei
cards.flavor: A Pokemon that races across the land. It is said that one is born every time a new volcano appears.

attacks.name: Mega Flame
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. For each tails, discard 1 Fire Energy card from Entei, if it has any.

ability.name: Legendary Body
ability.text: As long as Entei is your Active Pokemon, Entei and Energy cards attached to it aren't affected by effects from Trainer cards other than Stadium cards. As long as this Power is active, discard any Trainer cards attached to Entei. (This power works even if Entei is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.)

cards.name: Ho-oh
cards.flavor: A legend says that its body glows in seven colors. A rainbow is said to form behind it when it flies.

attacks.name: Rainbow Burn
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage plus 10 more damage for each type of Basic Energy card, if any, attached to Ho-Oh.

cards.name: Kingdra
cards.flavor: It sleeps deep on the ocean floor to build its energy. It is said to cause tornadoes as it wakes.

attacks.name: Genetic Memory
attacks.text: Use any attack from Kingdra's Basic Pokemon card or Evolution card. (Kingdra doesn't have to pay for that attack's Energy cost.)

attacks.name: Twister
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. For each heads, choose 1 Energy card attached to the Defending Pokemon, if any, and discard it. If both are tails, this attack does nothing (not even damage).

cards.name: Lugia
cards.flavor: It is said to be the guardian of the seas. It is rumored to have been seen on the night of a storm.

attacks.name: Aerowing
attacks.text: You may flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 80 damage. If tails, this attack does nothing.

cards.name: Raichu
cards.flavor: If the electric pouches in its cheeks become fully charged, both ears will stand straight up.

attacks.name: Thundershock
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokemon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Lightning Strike
attacks.text: You may discard all Lightning Energy cards attached to Raichu. If you do, this attack does 80 damage.

cards.name: Raikou
cards.flavor: A Pokemon that races across the land while barking a cry that sounds like crashing thunder.

attacks.name: Lightning Spark
attacks.text: If your opponent has any Benched Pokemon, flip a coin. If heads, choose 1 of them and this attack does 20 damage to it. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokemon.)

ability.name: Legendary Body
ability.text: As long as Raikou is your Active Pokemon, Raikou and Energy cards attached to it aren't affected by effects from Trainer cards other than Stadium cards. As long as this Power is active, discard any Trainer cards attached to Raikou. (This power works even if Raikou is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.)

cards.name: Skarmory
cards.flavor: After nesting in bramble bushes, the wings of its chicks grow hard from scratches by thorns.

attacks.name: Fury Attack
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Agility
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to Skarmory.

cards.name: Sneasel
cards.flavor: Its paws conceal sharp claws. If attacked, it suddenly extends the claws and startles its enemy.

attacks.name: Swipe
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, discard all Trainer cards attached to your opponent's Pokemon.

attacks.name: Quick Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage plus 20 more damage.

cards.name: Starmie
cards.flavor: The center section of its body is called the core. It glows in a different color each time it is seen.

attacks.name: Confuse Ray
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokemon is now Confused.

attacks.name: Core Stream
attacks.text: Choose an Energy type other than Colorless. This attack does 20 damage to each of your opponent's Pokemon with any Energy cards of that type attached to it. Don't apply Weakness and Resistance.

cards.name: Sudowoodo
cards.flavor: It disguises itself as a tree to avoid attack. It hates water, so it will disappear if it starts raining.

attacks.name: Slam
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.

ability.name: Mimic
ability.text: As long as Sudowoodo is your Active Pokemon, it copies all of the Defending Pokemon's attacks, including their costs. This power can't be used if Sudowoodo is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

cards.name: Suicune
cards.flavor: This Pokemon races across the land. It is said that north winds will somehow blow whenever it appears.

attacks.name: Crystal Wave
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 damage plus 10 more damage. If tails, this attack does 30 damage and, if your opponent has any Benched Pokemon, he or she chooses 1 of them and switches it with the Defending Pokemon. (Do the damage before switching the Pokemon.)

ability.name: Legendary Body
ability.text: As long as Suicune is your Active Pokemon, Suicune and Energy cards attached to it aren't affected by effects from Trainer cards other than Stadium cards. As long as this Power is active, discard any Trainer cards attached to Suicune. (This power works even if Suicune is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.)

cards.name: Flaaffy
cards.flavor: Its fluffy fleece easily stores electricity. Its rubbery hide keeps it from being electrocuted.

attacks.name: Tail Shock
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokemon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokemon.)

cards.name: Golbat
cards.flavor: It can drink more than 10 ounces of blood at once. If it has too much, it gets heavy and flies clumsily.

attacks.name: Screech
attacks.text: Until the end of your next turn, if an attack damages the Defending Pokemon (after applying Weakness and Resistance), that attack does 20 more damage to the Defending Pokemon.

attacks.name: Poison Bite
attacks.text: If this attack damages the Defending Pokemon, the Defending Pokemon is now Poisoned and you remove a number of damage counters from Golbat equal to half that damage (rounded up to the nearest 10). If Golbat has fewer damage counters than that, remove all of them. Either way, the Defending Pokemon is now Poisoned.

cards.name: Graveler
cards.flavor: With a free and uncaring nature, it doesn't mind if pieces break off while it rolls down mountains.

attacks.name: Earthquake
attacks.text: Does 10 damage to each of your own Benched Pokemon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokemon.)

attacks.name: Rock Tumble
attacks.text: Don't apply Resistance.

cards.name: Jynx
cards.flavor: It rocks its body rhythmically. It appears to alter the rhythm depending on how it is feeling.

attacks.name: Freezing Kiss Goodnight
attacks.text: The Defending Pokemon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Strange Dance
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 damage plus 20 more damage and the Defending Pokemon is now Confused. If tails, this attack does 20 damage.

cards.name: Lanturn
cards.flavor: It blinds prey with an intense burst of light, then swallows the immobilized prey in a single gulp.

attacks.name: Blinding Light
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokemon is now Confused.

ability.name: Submerge
ability.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may change Lanturn's type to Water until the end of your turn. This power can't be used if Lanturn is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed. If Lanturn becomes Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed after you have used this power, its type changes back to Lightning.

cards.name: Magcargo
cards.flavor: The shell on its back is just skin that has cooled and hardened. It breaks easily with a slight touch.

attacks.name: Lava Flow
attacks.text: You may discard any number of Fire Energy cards attached to Magcargo when you use this attack. If you do, this attack does 40 damage plus 20 more damage for each Fire Energy card you discarded in this way.

ability.name: Magma Pool
ability.text: If Magcargo is your Active Pokemon and moves to the Bench, remove 1 Fire Energy card attached to Magcargo, if any, and attach it to the new Active Pokemon. (You can't choose an Energy card that you used to pay the Retreat Cost.)

cards.name: Octillery
cards.flavor: It traps enemies with its suction cupped tentacles then smashes them with its rockhard head.

attacks.name: Constrict
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokemon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Octazooka
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, whenever the Defending Pokemon attacks, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, that attack does nothing. (Benching or evolving that Pokemon ends this effect.)

cards.name: Parasect
cards.flavor: It stays mostly in dark, damp places, the preference not of the bug, but of the big mushrooms on its back.

attacks.name: Sleep Pinchers
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokemon is now Asleep.

ability.name: Allergic Pollen
ability.text: As long as Parasect is in play, cards in any player's discard piles are not affected by attacks or Pokemon Powers. This power stops working if Parasect becomes Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

cards.name: Piloswine
cards.flavor: If it charges at an enemy, the hairs on its back stand up straight. It is very sensitive to sound.

attacks.name: Nap
attacks.text: Remove 3 damage counters from Piloswine. If it has fewer damage counters than that, remove all of them.

attacks.name: High-Speed Charge
attacks.text: Piloswine does 30 damage to itself. Piloswine can't use this attack during your next turn.

cards.name: Seaking
cards.flavor: Using its horn, it bores holes in riverbed boulders, making nests to prevent its eggs from washing away.

attacks.name: Rising Lunge
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage plus 10 more damage. If tails, this attack does 10 damage.

attacks.name: Horn Swipe
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. If both are heads, this attack does 20 damage plus 40 more damage. If 1 or both of them are tails, this attack does 20 damage.

cards.name: Stantler
cards.flavor: Those who stare at its antlers will gradually lose control of their senses and be unable to stand.

attacks.name: Terrorize
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokemon is a Basic Pokemon, choose 1 of its attacks. That Pokemon can't use that attack during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Overhead Toss
attacks.text: If you have any Benched Pokemon, flip a coin. If tails, this attack does 10 damage to 1 of them. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokemon.)

cards.name: Unown [B]
cards.flavor: Their shapes look like hieroglyphs on ancient tablets. It is said that the two are somehow related.

ability.name: [Bear]
ability.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may move 1 damage counter from 1 of your Pokemon with Unown in its name to Unown [B]. This power can't be used if Unown [B] has 10 HP left. This power can be used even if Unown [B] is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

cards.name: Unown [Y]
cards.flavor: Their shapes look like hieroglyphs on ancient tablets. It is said that the two are somehow related.

ability.name: [Yield]
ability.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for a Psychic Energy card and attach it to 1 of your Pokemon with Unown in its name. Shuffle your deck afterward. This power can be used even if Unown [Y] is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

cards.name: Aipom
cards.flavor: It lives atop tall trees. When leaping from branch to branch, it deftly uses its tail for balance.

attacks.name: Grab
attacks.text: Choose a Trainer card attached to 1 of your opponent's Pokemon. Your opponent shuffles that card into his or her deck.

cards.name: Chinchou
cards.flavor: On the dark ocean floor, its only means of communication is its constantly flashing lights.

attacks.name: Positive Ion
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage plus 10 more damage. If tails, this attack does 10 damage.

attacks.name: Negative Ion
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokemon attacks Chinchou during your opponent's next turn, any damage done to Chinchou is reduced by 10 (before applying Weakness and Resistance). (Benching or evolving either Pokemon ends this effect.)

cards.name: Farfetch'd
cards.flavor: If anyone tries to disturb where the essential plant sticks grow, it uses its own stick to thwart them.

attacks.name: Leek Jab
attacks.text: This attack can't be used during your next turn. (Benching Farfetch'd ends this effect.)

cards.name: Geodude
cards.flavor: It uses its arms to steadily climb steep mountain paths. It swings its fists around if angered.

cards.name: Goldeen
cards.flavor: Its dorsal, pectoral and tail fins wave elegantly in the water. That is why it is known as the water dancer.

attacks.name: Fin Smack
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

cards.name: Murkrow
cards.flavor: Feared and loathed by many, it is believed to bring misfortune to all those who see it at night.

attacks.name: Call for Family
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Basic Pokemon card named Murkrow and put it onto your Bench. Shuffle your deck afterward. (You can't use this attack if your Bench is full.)

attacks.name: Flock Attack
attacks.text: Flip a number of coins equal to the number of Murkrows on your Bench. This attack does 10 damage plus 10 more damage for each heads.

cards.name: Paras
cards.flavor: It is doused with mushroom spores when it is born. As its body grows, mushrooms sprout from its back.

attacks.name: Sleep Spore
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokemon is now Asleep.

cards.name: Quagsire
cards.flavor: Due to its relaxed and carefree attitude, it often bumps its head on boulders and boat hulls as it swims.

attacks.name: Whirlpool
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokemon has any Energy cards attached to it, choose 1 of them and discard it.

cards.name: Qwilfish
cards.flavor: To fire its poison spikes, it must inflate its body by drinking over 2.6 gallons of water all at once.

attacks.name: Poison Sting
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokemon is now Poisoned.

attacks.name: Needle Storm
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads you get.

cards.name: Remoraid
cards.flavor: It has superb accuracy. The water it shoots out can strike even moving prey from more than 300 feet.

attacks.name: Sharpshooting
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, choose 1 of your opponent's Pokemon. This attack does 20 damage to that Pokemon. Don't apply Weakness and Resistance.

cards.name: Shuckle
cards.flavor: It stores berries inside its shell. To avoid attacks, it hides beneath rocks and remains completely still.

attacks.name: Toxic Saliva
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokemon is now Poisoned. It now takes 20 Poison damage instead of 10 after each player's turn (even if it was already Poisoned).

ability.name: Hard Shell
ability.text: Whenever an attack (including your own) does 40 or less damage to Shuckle (after applying Weakness and Resistance), reduce that damage to 10. (Any other effects of attacks still happen.) This power stops working while Shuckle is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

cards.name: Skiploom
cards.flavor: It spreads its petals to absorb sunlight. It also floats in the air to get closer to the sun.

attacks.name: Mysterious Powder
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokemon is now Confused.

cards.name: Slugma
cards.flavor: It never sleeps. It has to keep moving because if it stopped, its magma body would cool and harden.

attacks.name: Magma Ring
attacks.text: The Defending Pokemon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

cards.name: Smoochum
cards.flavor: It always rocks its head slowly backwards and forwards as if it is trying to kiss someone.

attacks.name: Psykiss
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, choose a Special Energy card attached to 1 of your opponent's Pokemon. Your opponent shuffles that card into his or her deck.

cards.name: Snubbull
cards.flavor: It has an active, playful nature. Many people like to frolic with it because of its affectionate ways.

attacks.name: Raging Headbutt
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage plus 10 damage times the number of damage counters on Snubbull. If tails, this attack does 10 damage.

cards.name: Staryu
cards.flavor: At night, the center of its body slowly flickers with the same rhythm as a human heartbeat.

attacks.name: Bubblebeam
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokemon is now Paralyzed.

cards.name: Swinub
cards.flavor: If it smells something enticing, it dashes headlong off to find the source of the aroma.

attacks.name: Take Down
attacks.text: Swinub does 10 damage to itself.

cards.name: Unown [K]
cards.flavor: Their shapes look like hieroglyphs on ancient tablets. It is said that the two are somehow related.

ability.name: [Keep]
ability.text: Your opponent's attacks, Pokemon Powers, and Trainer cards can't discard Energy cards from your Pokemon with Unown in their names. (Any other effects still happen.)

cards.name: Zubat
cards.flavor: While flying, it constantly emits ultrasonic waves from its mouth to check its surroundings.

attacks.name: Poison Spray
attacks.text: The Defending Pokemon is now Poisoned.

cards.name: Balloon Berry
cards.text: Attach Balloon Berry to 1 of your Pokemon that doesn't have a Pokemon Tool attached to it. When the Pokemon Balloon Berry is attached to retreats, discard Balloon Berry instead of discarding Energy cards.

cards.name: Healing Field
cards.text: This card stays in play when you play it. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play. Once during each player's turn, he or she may flip a coin. If heads, that player removes 2 damage counters from his or her Active Pokemon (1 if it only has 1).

cards.name: Pokemon Breeder Fields
cards.text: Flip a coin for 1 or 2 of your non-Baby Pokemon that can evolve. For each heads, search your deck for a later-Stage card that matches that Pokemon. Then put that card into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

cards.name: Rocket's Hideout
cards.text: This card stays in play when you play it. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play. Each Pokemon in play with Dark in its name (even your opponent's) gets +20 HP.

cards.name: Old Rod
cards.text: Flip 2 coins. If both are heads, put a Baby Pokemon, Basic Pokemon, or Evolution card from your discard pile into your hand. If both are tails, put a Trainer card from your discard pile into your hand.

cards.name: Shining Gyarados
cards.flavor: Once it appears, it goes on a rampage. It remains enraged until it demolishes everything around it.

attacks.name: Outrage
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 damage plus 10 more damage for each damage counter on Shining Gyarados. If tails, this attack does nothing.

attacks.name: Devastate
attacks.text: Discard 2 Fire Energy cards attached to Shining Gyarados or this attack does nothing. This attack does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokemon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokemon.) Then, flip a coin. If heads, choose 1 Energy card attached to each of your opponent's Pokemon that has any Energy cards attached to it and discard those Energy cards.

cards.name: Shining Magikarp
cards.flavor: An underpowered, pathetic Pokemon. It may jump high on rare occasions, but never more than seven feet.

attacks.name: Gold Scale
attacks.text: Your opponent may draw 2 cards. Either way, you may draw 2 cards.

attacks.name: Dragon Bond
attacks.text: Search your deck for a card named Gyarados, Dark Gyarados, or Shining Gyarados. Show it to your opponent and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

cards.name: Dark Ampharos
cards.flavor: Its brightly lit tail can be seen for miles in the dark, even by ships on the sea.

attacks.name: Shock Bolt
attacks.text: Discard all Lightning Energy cards attached to Dark Ampharos or this attack does nothing.

ability.name: Conductivity
ability.text: Whenever your opponent attaches an Energy card from his or her hand to a Pokemon, this power does 10 damage to that Pokemon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance.) This power stops working if you have more than 1 Dark Ampharos in play or while Dark Ampharos is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

cards.name: Dark Crobat
cards.flavor: Although the wings it has evolved on its feet allow it to fly at high speeds, they unfortunately make it difficult to perch.

attacks.name: Dark Drain
attacks.text: Flip a coin for each of your opponent's Pokemon. For each heads, this attack does 10 damage to that Pokemon. Don't apply Weakness and Resistance. Remove a number of damage counters from Dark Crobat equal to the damage dealt. If Dark Crobat has fewer damage counters than that, remove all of them.

ability.name: Surprise Bite
ability.text: When you play Dark Crobat from your hand, you may choose 1 of your opponent's Pokemon. This power does 20 damage to that Pokemon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance.)

cards.name: Dark Donphan
cards.flavor: The larger its tusks, the higher its status in the herd.

attacks.name: Tusk Toss
attacks.text: If your opponent has any Benched Pokemon, flip a coin. If heads, return the Defending Pokemon and all cards attached to it to your opponent's hand. If tails, your opponent chooses 1 of his or her Benched Pokemon and switches it with the Defending Pokemon.

cards.name: Dark Espeon
cards.flavor: The tips of its split tail quiver whenever it uses its psychic abilities to read its opponent's next move.

attacks.name: Gouge
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage plus 10 more damage; if tails, this attack does 10 damage.

attacks.name: Psysplash
attacks.text: Does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Pokemon for each Energy card attached to that Pokemon. Don't apply Weakness and Resistance.

cards.name: Dark Feraligatr
cards.flavor: Its powerful muscles allow it to move at a speed that belies its bulk.

attacks.name: Crushing Blow
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokemon has any Energy cards attached to it, flip a coin. If heads, choose 1 of those cards and discard it.

ability.name: Scare
ability.text: As long as Dark Feraligatr is your Active Pokemon, all of your opponent's Baby Pokemon Powers stop working and your opponent's Baby Pokemon can't attack. This power stops working while Dark Feraligatr is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

cards.name: Dark Gengar
cards.flavor: It absorbs the heat in the air around it. If you suddenly feel cold, it's because a Gengar has appeared.

attacks.name: Pull In
attacks.text: If your opponent has any Benched Pokemon, you may choose 1 of them and switch it with the Defending Pokemon (before doing damage or other effects of this attack). Either way, the Defending Pokemon is now Asleep.

ability.name: Deep Sleep
ability.text: As long as any Dark Gengar are in play, a player flips 2 coins for each of his or her Pokemon that is Asleep at the end of each turn. If either of them is tails, that Pokemon is still Asleep. This power stops working if Dark Gengar is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

cards.name: Dark Houndoom
cards.flavor: The flame it breathes is actually a volatile poison it produces internally that ignites when exposed to air.

attacks.name: Eerie Howl
attacks.text: If your opponent's Bench isn't full, look at his or her hand. If your opponent has any Baby Pokemon or Basic Pokemon there, choose 1 of them and put it on his or her Bench. Then, switch it with the Defending Pokemon.

attacks.name: Dark Fire
attacks.text: If there are any Darkness Energy cards attached to Dark Houndoom, discard 1 of them and this attack does 30 damage plus 20 more damage (plus 10 more damage for the Darkness Energy you discarded). If there aren't any, this attack does 30 damage.

cards.name: Dark Porygon2
cards.flavor: Advances in technology have allowed it to evolve. It occasionally displays behavior not found in its programming.

attacks.name: Curve Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all damage done by attacks to Dark Porygon2 during your opponent's next turn. (Any other effects of attacks still happen.)

ability.name: Spatial Distortion
ability.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may flip a coin. If heads, choose a Stadium card from your discard pile and put it into play. (If there's already a Stadium card in play, discard it.) This power can't be used if Dark Porygon2 is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

cards.name: Dark Scizor
cards.flavor: Nothing can withstand the pressure of the vise-like grip of this Pokemon's steel claws.

attacks.name: Threaten
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, look at your opponent's hand. If he or she has any Trainer cards there, choose 1 of them. Your opponent shuffles that card into his or her deck.

cards.name: Dark Typhlosion
cards.flavor: When it's in combat, the air around it shimmers and warps from the intense heat it produces.

attacks.name: Rushing Flames
attacks.text: You may discard any number of Fire Energy cards attached to your Pokemon. Flip a coin for each Fire Energy card discarded in this way. This attack does 40 damage times the number of heads.

cards.name: Dark Tyranitar
cards.flavor: Its power is such that not even mountains can stand in its way.

attacks.name: Mountain Smasher
attacks.text: Flip a number of coins equal to the number of Fighting Energy cards attached to Dark Tyranitar. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads. Then, for each heads, discard the top card from your opponent's deck.

attacks.name: Fling Away
attacks.text: If your opponent has any Benched Pokemon, this attack does 30 damage instead of 50 and choose 1 of those Benched Pokemon. This attack does 30 damage to that Pokemon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokemon.)

cards.name: Light Arcanine
cards.flavor: This legendary Chinese Pokemon is easily recognized by its large flowing mane.

attacks.name: Gentle Flames
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokemon is a Baby Pokemon, this attack does 10 damage instead of 50. If the Defending Pokemon is a Basic Pokemon, this attack does 30 damage instead of 50.

ability.name: Drive Off
ability.text: As long as Light Arcanine is your Active Pokemon, once during your turn (before your attack), if your opponent has any Benched Pokemon, he or she chooses 1 of them and switches it with the Defending Pokemon. This power can't be used while Light Arcanine is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

cards.name: Light Azumarill
cards.flavor: It curls up its long ears when swimming to prevent water from entering them.

attacks.name: Bubble
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokemon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Bubble Jump
attacks.text: If you have any Benched Pokemon, flip a coin. If heads, take 2 Energy cards attached to Light Azumarill and attach them to 1 of your Benched Pokemon. Then return Light Azumarill and all cards attached to it to your hand.

cards.name: Light Dragonite
cards.flavor: It is said to fly constantly over the sea, looking for people in need of aid.

attacks.name: Light Wave
attacks.text: Prevent all effects of attacks, other than damage, done to Light Dragonite during your opponent's next turn.

ability.name: Miraculous Wind
ability.text: As long as Light Dragonite is your Active Pokemon, each Special Energy card provides Colorless Energy instead of its usual type and its other effects stop working. This power stops working while Light Dragonite is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

cards.name: Light Togetic
cards.flavor: It becomes depressed if it is not near kind-hearted people. Is is able to float in the air without moving its wings.

attacks.name: Sweet Kiss
attacks.text: Your opponent may draw a card.

ability.name: Gift
ability.text: When you play Light Togetic from your hand, your opponent may search his or her deck for a Pokemon Tool card, show that card to you, and put it into his or her hand. Either way, you may do the same, and then each player who searched shuffles his or her deck.

cards.name: Miracle Energy
cards.text: You can't have more than 1 Miracle Energy in your deck. Attach Miracle Energy to 1 of your Shining or Light Pokemon. At the end of your turn, discard Miracle Energy. While in play, Miracle Energy counts as every type of Energy but provides only 2 Energy at a time.

cards.name: Dark Ariados
cards.flavor: Wherever it goes, it spins a thread that always leads back to its web.

attacks.name: Entangle
