attacks.text: If your opponent has any Benched Pokemon, choose 1 of them and switch it with the Defending Pokemon, then flip a coin. If heads, the new Defending Pokemon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Poison Bind
attacks.text: The Defending Pokemon is now Poisoned. Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokemon can't retreat until the end of your opponent's next turn and if the effect of an attack, Pokemon Power, or Trainer card would change that player's Active Pokemon, that part of the effect does nothing.

cards.name: Dark Magcargo
cards.flavor: The shell on its back comes off easily, exposing the flames running through its body.

attacks.name: Ball of Flame
attacks.text: You may discard a Fire Energy card attached to Dark Magcargo when you use this attack. If you do and if your opponent has any Benched Pokemon, choose 1 of them and this attack does 20 damage to it. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokemon.)

ability.name: Hot Plate
ability.text: As long as Dark Magcargo is your Active Pokemon, whenever a player puts a Baby Pokemon or Basic Pokemon onto his or her Bench from his or her hand, this power does 10 damage to that Pokemon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance.) This power stops working if Dark Magcargo is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

cards.name: Dark Omastar
cards.flavor: Nothing can escape once wrapped in its tentacles, which it uses for self-defense as well as to catch food.

attacks.name: Prehistoric Water
attacks.text: If your opponent has any evolved Pokemon in play, choose 1 of them and flip a coin. If heads, your opponent takes the highest Stage Evolution card on that Pokemon and shuffles it into his or her deck.

attacks.name: Dark Tentacle
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokemon can't evolve except from effects of attacks or Pokemon Powers. (Benching that Pokemon ends this effect.)

cards.name: Dark Slowking
cards.flavor: Each time it yawns, the Shellder on its head releases an enzyme that makes it grow even smarter.

attacks.name: Mind Shock
attacks.text: Don't apply Weakness or Resistance for this attack.

ability.name: Cunning
ability.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may flip a coin. If heads, look at the top card of your opponent's deck. Then, you may have your opponent shuffle his or her deck. This power can't be used if Dark Slowking is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

cards.name: Dark Ursaring
cards.flavor: Its keen nose can pick out any scent, even that of food buried deep underground.

attacks.name: Provoke
attacks.text: Look at your opponent's hand. If he or she has any Baby Pokemon and/or Basic Pokemon there, you may put any number of them onto your opponent's Bench (as long as there's room). Then, your opponent looks at your hand. If you have any Baby Pokemon and/or Basic Pokemon there, your opponent may put any number of them onto your Bench (as long as there's room).

attacks.name: Battle Frenzy
attacks.text: For each Pokemon in play (yours and your opponent's), flip a coin. For each heads, this attack does 20 damage to that Pokemon. Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for this attack.

cards.name: Light Dragonair
cards.flavor: The aura it projects from its body has an effect on the surrounding climate and weather.

attacks.name: Healing Light
attacks.text: Remove 1 damage counter from each of your Pokemon that has any damage counters on it.

attacks.name: Protective Wave
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to Light Dragonair.

cards.name: Light Lanturn
cards.flavor: This Pokemon has evolved its dorsal fin to emit light, which attracts the fish it feeds on.

attacks.name: Searchlight
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, each player may choose a card from his or her discard pile and put it into his or her hand.

attacks.name: Spark
attacks.text: If your opponent has any Benched Pokemon, choose 1 of them and this attack does 10 damage to it. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokemon.)

cards.name: Light Ledian
cards.flavor: The number of spots on its back increase or decrease depending on the number of stars visible in the night sky.

attacks.name: Flash Touch
attacks.text: If you have any Benched Pokemon, switch 1 of them with Light Ledian. As long as that Pokemon is your Active Pokemon, it can't become Asleep, Confused, Paralyzed, or Poisoned. (All other effects of attacks, Pokemon Powers, and Trainer cards still happen.)

attacks.name: Comet Punch
attacks.text: Flip 4 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.

cards.name: Light Machamp
cards.flavor: It uses its four arms in combat to unleash a ceaseless flurry of punches.

attacks.name: Beatdown
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokemon has Dark in its name or is a Darkness Pokemon, flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 100 damage instead of 50.

ability.name: Tag Team
ability.text: When you play Light Machamp from your hand, if it is on your Bench, remove 3 damage counters from your Active Pokemon. If it has fewer damage counters than that, remove all of them. Then, switch Light Machamp with your Active Pokemon.

cards.name: Light Piloswine
cards.flavor: Its legs are short, but its hooves are wide and flat, allowing it to easily walk over snow.

attacks.name: Knock Over
attacks.text: If there is a Stadium card in play, you may discard it.

ability.name: Fluffy Wool
ability.text: During your opponent's turn, if Light Piloswine is your Active Pokemon and is damaged by your opponent's attack (even if it's Knocked Out), flip a coin. If heads, the attacking Pokemon is now Asleep. This power stops working if Light Piloswine is already Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed when your opponent attacks.

cards.name: Unown [G]
cards.flavor: It is believed that the variety of types of this Pokemon were created by evolutionary adaptation, as each possesses a different ability.

ability.name: [Give]
ability.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), if you have Unown [G], Unown [I], Unown [V], and Unown [E] on your Bench, you may flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for a basic Energy card and attach it to 1 of your Pokemon. Shuffle your deck afterward.

cards.name: Unown [H]
cards.flavor: It is believed that the variety of types of this Pokemon were created by evolutionary adaptation, as each possesses a different ability.

ability.name: [Help]
ability.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), if you have Unown [H], Unown [E], Unown [L], and Unown [P] on your Bench, you may shuffle your hand into your deck, then draw a new hand of the same number of cards.

cards.name: Unown [W]
cards.flavor: It is believed that the variety of types of this Pokemon were created by evolutionary adaptation, as each possesses a different ability.

ability.name: [Want]
ability.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), if you have Unown [W], Unown [A], Unown [N], and Unown [T] on your Bench, you may flip a coin. If heads, put a Trainer card from your discard pile into your hand.

cards.name: Unown [X]
cards.flavor: It is believed that the variety of types of this Pokemon were created by evolutionary adaptation, as each possesses a different ability.

ability.name: [XXXXX]
ability.text: Whenever 1 of your Pokemon with Unown in its name uses its Hidden Power attack, flip a coin until you get tails. That attack does 10 more damage for each heads. If you have more than 1 Unown [X] in play, use only 1 [XXXXX] each turn.

cards.name: Chansey
cards.flavor: It holds its egg carefully when moving so as not to break it. Still, it is fast enough to disappear in the blink of an eye.

attacks.name: Doubleslap
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Egg Toss
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. If either of them is tails, this attack does nothing.

cards.name: Dark Croconaw
cards.flavor: It has 49 teeth in its mouth that are constantly replacing themselves. Pull one out, and a new one grows in.

attacks.name: Clamping Jaw
attacks.text: The Defending Pokemon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn. If the Defending Pokemon tries to attack during your opponent's next turn, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, that attack does nothing. (Benching either Pokemon ends this effect.)

cards.name: Dark Exeggutor
cards.flavor: If one of its heads falls off, it turns into an Exeggcute, which begins to look for other Exeggcutes using a special form of telepathy.

attacks.name: Triple Headbutt
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: MAX Burst
attacks.text: Flip a number of coins equal to the number of Energy cards attached to your opponent's Pokemon. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.

cards.name: Dark Flaaffy
cards.flavor: As a result of storing massive amounts of electricity there, it can no longer grow wool on certain areas of its body.

attacks.name: High Voltage
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent can't play Trainer cards during his or her next turn.

attacks.name: Stun Wave
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokemon has a Pokemon Power, that power stops working until the end of your next turn.

cards.name: Dark Forretress
cards.flavor: It stays motionless in trees, driving away with flying armored shards from its hard shell any who come close.

attacks.name: Armor Up
attacks.text: Until the end of your next turn, if Dark Forretress would be Knocked Out by damage from an attack, flip a coin. If heads, Dark Forretress is not Knocked Out and its remaining HP become 10 instead.

attacks.name: Explosion
attacks.text: Dark Forretress does 60 damage to itself.

cards.name: Dark Haunter
cards.flavor: It silently hunts its prey in dark rooms.

attacks.name: Call Back
attacks.text: Put a Baby Pokemon or Basic Pokemon card from your opponent's discard pile onto his or her Bench. Put 1 damage counter on that Pokemon. (You can't use this attack if your Bench is full.)

attacks.name: Surround
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokemon is now Asleep. If tails, the Defending Pokemon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

cards.name: Dark Omanyte
cards.flavor: This ancient Pokemon possessed 10 tentacles, which it used to swim through the ocean.

attacks.name: Water Cannon
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokemon. This attack does 10 damage for each Water Energy card attached to Dark Omanyte. Don't apply Weakness and Resistance. You can't do more than 30 damage in this way.

cards.name: Dark Pupitar
cards.flavor: It is encased within a hard shell, yet retains a great deal of mobility-a dangerous combination.

attacks.name: Rock Tackle
attacks.text: Dark Pupitar does 10 damage to itself. Dark Pupitar can't use this attack during your next turn.

attacks.name: Explosive Evolution
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Pokemon. Don't apply Weakness and Resistance. Then, search your deck for an Evolution card named Dark Tyranitar and put it on Dark Pupitar. (This counts as evolving Dark Pupitar.) Shuffle your deck afterward.

cards.name: Dark Quilava
cards.flavor: If it turns its back to an opponent, it is a sign that it is getting ready to attack.

attacks.name: Incinerate
attacks.text: Show the top card of your opponent's deck to all players. If it's a Trainer card, discard it.

attacks.name: Rushing Magma
attacks.text: Discard the top 5 cards of your deck. (If there are fewer than 5 cards in your deck, discard all of them.) This attack does 20 damage for each Fire Energy card you discarded in this way.

cards.name: Dark Wigglytuff
cards.flavor: This Pokemon has soft, fine hair. When angered, it increases in size and has been known to charge those it considers a threat.

attacks.name: Dark Song
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokemon is now Asleep. If tails, the Defending Pokemon is now Confused.

attacks.name: Slap Awake
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokemon is Asleep or Confused, this attack does 20 damage plus 20 more damage. Then, the Defending Pokemon is no longer Asleep or Confused.

cards.name: Heracross
cards.flavor: It is normally peaceful, but will attack any who get between it and honey, its favorite food.

attacks.name: Charging Horn
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 damage plus 30 more damage. If tails, this attack does 30 damage.

cards.name: Hitmonlee
cards.flavor: It has a perfect sense of balance and can lash out with powerful kicks from any position.

attacks.name: One-Two Kick
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Heel Drop
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

cards.name: Houndour
cards.flavor: When night falls, the air fills with the eerie cries of this Pokemon as it stakes out its territory.

attacks.name: Corner
attacks.text: The Defending Pokemon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Lunge
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

cards.name: Jigglypuff
cards.flavor: If puffs its body up like a balloon and sings a lullaby that makes all who hear it fall into a deep sleep.

attacks.name: Expand
attacks.text: All damage done to Jigglypuff during your opponent's next turn is reduced by 10 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.name: Light Dewgong
cards.flavor: It has an aerodynamic shape that allows it to swim at great speeds. The colder the water gets, the more active it becomes.

attacks.name: Freezing Breath
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokemon is now Paralyzed. If tails, the Defending Pokemon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Ice Pillar
attacks.text: Until the end of your opponent's next turn, as long as Light Dewgong is your Active Pokemon, prevent all damage done by attacks to your Benched Pokemon. (Any other effects of attacks still happen.)

cards.name: Light Flareon
cards.flavor: It creates its flames by swallowing air into a special pouch within its body, then heating it to over 3000 degrees.

attacks.name: Warm Up
attacks.text: If you have any benched Pokemon, search your deck for a Fire Energy card and attach it to 1 of them. Then shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Burning Flame
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. For each heads, discard a Fire Energy card attached to Light Flareon or this attack does nothing. This attack does 30 damage plus 20 damage for each heads.

cards.name: Light Golduck
cards.flavor: The faster it swims, the brighter the glow on its forehead becomes.

attacks.name: Flipper Stroke
attacks.text: Your opponent looks at the top 3 cards of his or her deck. If any of them are basic Energy cards, he or she may show any number of them to you and put them into his or her hand. You do the same. Either way, each player shuffles his or her deck.

attacks.name: Core Blast
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage plus 20 more damage for each Special Energy card attached to the Defending Pokemon.

cards.name: Light Jolteon
cards.flavor: It can collect the ambient electrical energy in its cells and expel it in massive bursts.

attacks.name: Pulse Guard
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, whenever 30 or more damage is done to Light Jolteon (after applying Weakness and Resistance), prevent that damage. (Any other effects of attacks still happen.)

attacks.name: Thunder Needle
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads. If you get 2 or more heads, the Defending Pokemon is now Paralyzed.

cards.name: Light Machoke
cards.flavor: This Pokemon never gets tired, no matter what it does or how hard it works.

attacks.name: Return Home
attacks.text: If you have any Benched Pokemon, shuffle 1 of them and all cards attached to it into your deck.

attacks.name: Gentle Kick
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokemon has no damage counters on it, this attack does 40 damage. If it has any, this attack does 20 damage.

cards.name: Light Ninetales
cards.flavor: It is said that each of its nine tails contains a different magical power.

attacks.name: Guiding Flame
attacks.text: Put a Baby Pokemon or a Basic Pokemon card from your discard pile onto your Bench. (You can't use this attack if your Bench is full.)

attacks.name: Fire Blast
attacks.text: Discard a Fire Energy card attached to Light Ninetales in order to use this attack.

cards.name: Light Slowbro
cards.flavor: If the Shellder attached to its tail becomes separated, this Pokemon reverts to a normal Slowpoke.

attacks.name: Fish Out
attacks.text: Your opponent may choose up to 3 Baby Pokemon, Basic Pokemon, and/or Evolution cards from his or her discard pile and shuffle them into his or her deck. Either way, you may do the same.

attacks.name: Splash About
attacks.text: If there are more Energy attached to the Defending Pokemon than to Light Slowbro, this attack does 20 damage plus 20 more damage. If not, this attack does 20 damage.

cards.name: Light Vaporeon
cards.flavor: If its fins being to vibrate, it is a sign that it will begin raining soon.

attacks.name: Wash Away
attacks.text: If you have any Benched Pokemon, flip a coin. If heads, remove all damage counters from 1 of your Benched Pokemon and discard all Energy cards attached to it.

attacks.name: Hypnoshower
attacks.text: The Defending Pokemon is now Asleep. Remove 1 damage counter from each Benched Pokemon (yours and your opponent's) with any damage counters on it.

cards.name: Light Venomoth
cards.flavor: It defends itself by flapping its wings at high speed, spreading poisonous powder throughout the air.

attacks.name: Mysterious Wing
attacks.text: Your opponent may choose a Baby Pokemon, Basic Pokemon, or Evolution card from his or her discard pile and put it into his or her hand. Either way, you may do the same.

attacks.name: Synchronize
attacks.text: If Light Venomoth and the Defending Pokemon have a different number of Energy cards attached to them, this attack does nothing.

cards.name: Light Wigglytuff
cards.flavor: If two of them brush against each other, they will not be able to separate themselves, as they enjoy touching each other's soft fur too much.

attacks.name: Evolution Song
attacks.text: Your opponent may choose 1 of his or her Pokemon and search his or her deck for a card that evolves from that Pokemon. Your opponent attaches that card to that Pokemon. This counts as evolving that Pokemon. Either way, you may do the same, and then each player who searched shuffles his or her deck.

attacks.name: Body Slam
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokemon is now Paralyzed.

cards.name: Scyther
cards.flavor: It moves so fast as to be invisible to the naked eye. Even when standing still, its camouflage prevents it from being seen.

attacks.name: Agility
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to Scyther.

cards.name: Togepi
cards.flavor: Its shell is said to contain happiness itself, which it will share with those who are kind to it.

attacks.name: Charm
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokemon attacks during your opponent's next turn, any damage it does is reduced by 10 (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Spike Ball Tackle
attacks.text: Togepi does 10 damage to itself.

cards.name: Unown [C]
cards.flavor: It is believed that the variety of types of this Pokemon were created by evolutionary adaptation, as each possesses a different ability.

ability.name: [Chase]
ability.text: As long as Unown [C] is your Active Pokemon, whenever your opponent's Active Pokemon tries to retreat, flip a coin. If heads, put 1 damage counter on that Pokemon. Apply Weakness and Resistance.

cards.name: Unown [P]
cards.flavor: It is believed that the variety of types of this Pokemon were created by evolutionary adaptation, as each possesses a different ability.

ability.name: [Perform]
ability.text: If an attack damaged Unown [P] during your opponent's last turn and Unown [P] was your Active Pokemon, Unown [P]'s Hidden Power attack does that much more damage to the Defending Pokemon. This power can be used even if Unown [P] is Confused.

cards.name: Unown [Q]
cards.flavor: It is believed that the variety of types of this Pokemon were created by evolutionary adaptation, as each possesses a different ability.

ability.name: [Quicken]
ability.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may flip a coin. If heads, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to any of your Pokemon with Unown in its name during your opponent's next turn. If you have more than 1 Unown [Q] in play, use only 1 [Quicken] each turn. This power can be used even if Unown [Q] is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

cards.name: Unown [Z]
cards.flavor: It is believed that the variety of types of this Pokemon were created by evolutionary adaptation, as each possesses a different ability.

ability.name: [Zoom]
ability.text: As long as Unown [Z] is Benched, you pay no Energy cost to retreat a Pokemon with Unown in its name.

cards.name: Cyndaquil
cards.flavor: It is very meek and constantly crouches in a defensive posture. When threatened, it protects itself with the flame on its back.

attacks.name: Smokescreen
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokemon tries to attack during your opponent's next turn, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, that attack does nothing.

cards.name: Dark Octillery
cards.flavor: It likes to sleep in rock caves and will even steal other Octillery's nests.

attacks.name: Ink Blast
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage plus 10 more damage for each Energy attached to Dark Octillery but not used to pay for this attack's Energy cost. You can't add more than 20 damage in this way.

attacks.name: Tentacle Wrap
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokemon is now Paralyzed. If tails, during your opponent's next turn, your opponent pays Colorless more to retreat the Defending Pokemon.

cards.name: Dratini
cards.flavor: Large from birth, this Pokemon increases in size throughout its life by regularly shedding its skin.

attacks.name: Shed
attacks.text: Remove 1 damage counter from Dratini.

attacks.name: Fury Attack
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

cards.name: Exeggcute
cards.flavor: Its shell is very durable, allowing it to survive even if the shell becomes cracked.

attacks.name: Sleep Powder
attacks.text: The Defending Pokemon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Psyshock
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokemon is now Paralyzed.

cards.name: Gastly
cards.flavor: Its gas-like body allows it to enter almost anywhere, but it is vulnerable to high winds.

attacks.name: Nightmare
attacks.text: The Defending Pokemon is now Asleep.

cards.name: Girafarig
cards.flavor: Its tail has a brain of its own, which can respond to stimuli such as scents. Many unsuspecting people have been bitten by it.

attacks.name: Tail Bite
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage plus 20 more damage; if tails, this attack does 10 damage.

attacks.name: Psychic
attacks.text: Does 10 damage plus 10 more damage for each Energy card attached to the Defending Pokemon.

cards.name: Gligar
cards.flavor: It spends its days hanging from cliffs, swooping down on any prey it spots from its high vantage point.

attacks.name: Stun Poison
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokemon is now Paralyzed and Poisoned.

cards.name: Growlithe
cards.flavor: It fears nothing, not even opponents larger than itself.

cards.name: Hitmonchan
cards.flavor: Its punches are blindingly fast, but it can only fight for three minutes before tiring and needing to rest.

attacks.name: Dodge
attacks.text: If Hitmonchan would be damaged by an attack during your opponent's next turn, flip a coin. If heads, prevent that attack's damage done to Hitmonchan. (Any other effects of attacks still happen.)

cards.name: Larvitar
cards.flavor: It is born deep within the ground and has to burrow its way out.

attacks.name: Leer
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokemon can't attack during your opponent's next turn. (Benching or evolving either Pokemon ends this effect.)

cards.name: Ledyba
cards.flavor: Sensitive to cold, Ledyba gather in groups to share warmth when the temperature drops.

attacks.name: Swift
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness, Resistance, Pokemon Powers, or any other effects on the Defending Pokemon.

cards.name: Light Sunflora
cards.flavor: Although it is extremely active during the day, it stops moving entirely as soon as the sun sets.

attacks.name: Reflected Sunlight
attacks.text: Attach up to 2 Grass Energy cards from your hand to 1 of your Grass Pokemon.

cards.name: Machop
cards.flavor: When bored, this super-strong Pokemon trains by lifting rocks.

cards.name: Mantine
cards.flavor: This Pokemon is perfectly adapted to its ocean home. It can gather up enough speed to burst above the water like a whale.

attacks.name: Giant Wave
attacks.text: Mantine can't attack during your next turn.

cards.name: Mareep
cards.flavor: Its soft wool coat captures air, allowing it to remain cool during the summer and warm in the winter.

cards.name: Phanpy
cards.flavor: It hits people with its nose as a sign of affection but doesn't know its own strength and so sometimes knocks people off their feet.

attacks.name: Crushing Step
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage plus 10 more damage; if tails, this attack does 10 damage.

cards.name: Pineco
cards.flavor: It waits suspended from tree branches for insects to fly into its mouth, often not moving for hours at a time.

cards.name: Porygon
cards.flavor: This Pokemon was created by human computer engineering. Its program is only capable of simple action and reaction.

cards.name: Psyduck
cards.flavor: Although possessed of great mental powers, it doesn't know how to use them.

attacks.name: Migraine
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokemon is now Confused. If tails, Psyduck is now Confused.

cards.name: Remoraid
cards.flavor: It can shoot a burst of water from its mouth to propel itself backward at high speeds, allowing it to flee from surprised enemies.

attacks.name: Fury Strikes
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

cards.name: Seel
cards.flavor: Although clumsy on land, it moves easily through the arctic waters it calls home.

attacks.name: Take Down
attacks.text: Seel does 10 damage to itself.

cards.name: Slugma
cards.flavor: This Pokemon is often seen crawling around in volcanic regions.

cards.name: Sunkern
cards.flavor: It is very small and powerless. If attacked, the best it can do is flap its leaves in an attempt to frighten away its enemies.

attacks.name: Sunbathe
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, remove all damage counters from Sunkern. Search your deck for a card that evolves from Sunkern and attach that card to Sunkern. This counts as evolving Sunkern. Shuffle your deck afterward.

cards.name: Swinub
cards.flavor: It moves with its sensitive nose pressed to the ground, always searching for food.

attacks.name: Generate Cold
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokemon is now Paralyzed.

cards.name: Totodile
cards.flavor: Its highly developed jaws are powerful enough to crush anything. Even experienced adult trainers must handle it with great caution.

attacks.name: Water Gun
attacks.text: Does 10 damage plus 10 more damage for each Water Energy attached to Totodile but not used to pay for this attack's Energy cost. You can't add more than 20 damage in this way.

cards.name: Unown [L]
cards.flavor: It is believed that the variety of types of this Pokemon were created by evolutionary adaptation, as each possesses a different ability.

ability.name: [Laugh]
ability.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may flip a coin. If heads, each player shuffles his or her deck. This power can be used even if Unown [L] is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

cards.name: Unown [S]
cards.flavor: It is believed that the variety of types of this Pokemon were created by evolutionary adaptation, as each possesses a different ability.

ability.name: [Search]
ability.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may look at 1 of your Prize cards. Return that Prize card face down. This power can be used even if Unown [S] is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

cards.name: Unown [T]
cards.flavor: It is believed that the variety of types of this Pokemon were created by evolutionary adaptation, as each possesses a different ability.

ability.name: [Tell]
ability.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may flip a coin. If heads, look at your opponent's hand and show your hand to your opponent. This power can be used even if Unown [T] is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

cards.name: Unown [V]
cards.flavor: It is believed that the variety of types of this Pokemon were created by evolutionary adaptation, as each possesses a different ability.

ability.name: [Vanish]
ability.text: When you play Unown [V] from your hand, you may flip a coin. If heads, return 1 of your Pokemon with Unown in its name (other than Unown [V]) to your hand. (Discard all cards attached to that card.)

cards.name: Venonat
cards.flavor: It possesses a type of radar, which it can use to find the insects it eats for food, even in pitch darkness.

attacks.name: Poisonpowder
attacks.text: The Defending Pokemon is now Poisoned.

cards.name: Vulpix
cards.flavor: As it grows older, its white tail changes colors and splits into six different tails. Its body radiates a faint warmth.

attacks.name: Ember
attacks.text: Discard 1 Fire Energy card attached to Vulpix in order to use this attack.

cards.name: Broken Ground Gym
cards.text: This card stays in play when you play it. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play. Each player pays Colorless more to retreat a Baby Pokemon or Basic Pokemon.

cards.name: EXP.ALL
cards.text: Attach EXP.ALL to 1 of your Pokemon that doesn't have a Pokemon Tool attached to it. During your opponent's turn, if your Active Pokemon would be Knocked Out by your opponent's attack, you may take 1 of the basic Energy cards attached to your Active Pokemon and attach it to the Pokemon with EXP.ALL attached to it. If you do, discard EXP.ALL.

cards.name: Impostor Professor Oak's Invention
cards.text: Look at your opponent's Prize cards. You may have your opponent shuffle them into his or her deck. If you do, your opponent takes that many cards from the top of his or her deck and sets them aside as his or her new Prize cards (without looking at them).

cards.name: Radio Tower
cards.text: This card stays in play when you play it. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play. Once during each player's turn (before attacking), that player may look at the top 2 cards of his or her deck and put them back in the same order.

cards.name: Thought Wave Machine
cards.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. For each heads, return an Energy card attached to your opponent's Active Pokemon to your opponent's hand. If the Pokemon has fewer attached Energy cards than that, return all of them to your opponent's hand. Your turn is over now (you don't get to attack).

cards.name: Counterattack Claws
cards.text: Attach Counterattack Claws to 1 of your Pokemon that doesn't have a Pokemon Tool attached to it. During your opponent's turn, if the Pokemon Counterattack Claws is attached to is your Active Pokemon and an opponent's attack damages it (even if it is Knocked Out), flip a coin. If heads, put 2 damage counters on the Defending Pokemon. Then, discard Counterattack Claws.

cards.name: Energy Amplifier
cards.text: Choose an Energy card in your hand, show it to your opponent, and shuffle it into your deck. Then flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for up to 3 basic Energy cards. Show them to your opponent, and put them into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

cards.name: Energy Stadium
cards.text: This card stays in play when you play it. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play. Once during each player's turn (before attacking), that player may flip a coin. If heads, that player puts a basic Energy card from his or her discard pile into his or her hand.

cards.name: Lucky Stadium
cards.text: This card stays in play when you play it. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play. Once during each player's turn (before attacking), that player may flip a coin. If heads, that player draws a card.

cards.name: Magnifier
cards.text: Attach Magnifier to 1 of your Pokemon. At the end of your turn, discard Magnifier. If the Pokemon Magnifier is attached to attacks, don't apply Resistance for that attack.

cards.name: Pokemon Personality Test
cards.text: Put an Evolution card from your hand face down in front of you. Your opponent guesses whether it is a Pokemon card with Light in its name, a Pokemon card with Dark in its name, or neither one. Flip the card over. If your opponent guessed right, he or she draws 3 cards. If your opponent guessed wrong, you draw 3 cards. Either way, return the card to your hand.

cards.name: Team Rocket's Evil Deeds
cards.text: Look at your opponent's hand and choose a card there. Your opponent shuffles that card into his or her deck. Then, your opponent may draw up to 2 cards.

cards.name: Heal Powder
cards.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your Active Pokemon is no longer Asleep, Confused, Paralyzed, or Poisoned and remove 2 damage counters from it. If your Active Pokemon has fewer damage counters than that, remove all of them.

cards.name: Mail from Bill
cards.text: You can't play this card if you have 5 or more cards in your hand (including this one). Draw cards until you have exactly 4 cards in your hand.

cards.name: Shining Celebi
cards.flavor: It is worshipped as a god of the forest. It appears only in undisturbed old-growth forests.

attacks.name: Healing Water
attacks.text: Remove a number of damage counters from 1 of your Benched Pokemon equal to the number of Water Energy cards attached to Shining Celebi. If the Pokemon has fewer damage counters than that, remove all of them.

attacks.name: Miracle Leaf
attacks.text: Flip a number of coins equal to the number of Energy attached to the Defending Pokemon. If you get 1 or more heads, the Defending Pokemon is now Asleep, Confused, or Poisoned (your choice).

cards.name: Shining Charizard
cards.flavor: The flames it breathes are so hot that they can melt anything.

attacks.name: White-hot Flame
attacks.text: Discard 1 Fire Energy card and 1 Lightning Energy card attached to Shining Charizard or this attack does nothing. Flip a coin. If tails, Shining Charizard does 30 damage to itself.

cards.name: Shining Kabutops
cards.flavor: This ancient Pokemon uses its razor-sharp claws to cut open its prey and gain access to its blood.

attacks.name: Lightning Cut
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 damage plus 10 more damage and does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokemon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokemon.) If tails, this attack does 30 damage and Shining Kabutops does 10 damage to itself.

attacks.name: Water Slash
